# EZD-296 · Fix: the sources bucket limits file types and size

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-296-1, AC-EZD-296-2
- **Complexity:** medium
- **Areas:** migrations, security, storage, testing
- **User-visible result:** uploaded originals (scans, PDFs, DXFs, photos) are refused by Storage unless they are an allowed file type and within the size limit, so nobody can store a web page or script as a "source file".
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-02 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Types `L` = `['image/vnd.dxf', 'model/gltf-binary', 'application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/heic']` (Q-0513 (a), Josh 2026-11-03: photos and images JPEG, PNG, HEIC; order reports PDF only; field measure files the photo types; DXF, Polycam GLB, PDF as named); size `N` = 52,428,800 bytes (Q-0514 (a), Josh 2026-11-03: 50 MiB per file, no setting or billing change).

Data: no table or policy change. One forward-only migration sets `storage.buckets` `sources` `allowed_mime_types` = `L`, `file_size_limit` = `N` (Q-0477; same shape as EZD-290's merged `20261102201341_set_media_bucket_limits.sql`, proven on the pinned stack by its T6, L-009).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `supabase/migrations/<ts>_set_sources_bucket_limits.sql` (`<ts>` = UTC now at build, sorting after every file on develop; newest today `20261102210539`) | new | SQL: header comment citing EZD-296, Q-0477, this plan; `update storage.buckets set allowed_mime_types = array[<L in order>], file_size_limit = <N> where id = 'sources';` | `supabase/migrations/20261102201341_set_media_bucket_limits.sql` | T1 |
| 2 | `app/src/lib/storage/source-file-kinds.ts` | change (append) | `export const SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES = [<L in order>] as const;` `export type SourceContentType = (typeof SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES)[number];` `export const SOURCE_MAX_BYTES = 52_428_800;` with a comment: same values as the step 1 migration | `SOURCE_FILE_KINDS` in the same file | `pnpm run typecheck`; T1 |
| 3 | `app/src/server/storage/source-files.ts` | change | signatures unchanged; `startSchema.contentType` gains `.refine((v) => (SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(v))` after `.regex(CONTENT_TYPE_RE)`; `startSchema.size` max becomes `SOURCE_MAX_BYTES` (replacing `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`) | the existing `startSchema` chain | T4 |
| 4 | `docs/architecture.md` `## Storage buckets and paths`, the **Buckets** bullet | change | "no bucket size or type limit except `media`" → "except `media` and `sources`"; add after the `media` sentence: "`sources` (EZD-296, `<ts>_set_sources_bucket_limits.sql`) takes only `L` up to `N` bytes (`SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES`, `SOURCE_MAX_BYTES`, `app/src/lib/storage/source-file-kinds.ts`; Q-0477); `startSourceFileUpload` refuses any other type or size with `invalid_input`; no wildcard types (R-052: `image/*` admits `image/svg+xml`)." | the `media` sentence in the same bullet | `node vault/tools/outline.mjs docs/architecture.md --section 'Storage buckets and paths'` |

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Which types | `L` exactly, in that order (first appearance by kind in 03c:15: polycam_dxf, polycam_glb, pdf; then the image kinds); one list for the whole bucket, not per kind (Storage limits per bucket) | 03c-tables.md:15; R-052 (IANA strings); Q-0513 (a) |
| D2 Wildcards and aliases | none: no `image/*`, no `application/dxf`, no `application/octet-stream` | R-052 (`image/*` matches `image/svg+xml`); L-006 |
| D3 Size | `N` = 52,428,800 (50 MiB), equal to today's global `file_size_limit = "50MiB"` in `supabase/config.toml`; ≥ 7,340,155 (`X_BYTES` in `storage.db.test.ts`), so existing uploads still pass | Q-0514 (a); R-052 (bucket limit cannot exceed the global) |
| D4 Start check order | `contentType` is trimmed and lower-cased first (existing chain), then checked against `SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES`; failure → existing `StorageError('invalid_input')`, no row inserted | `source-files.ts` startSchema; Decided Build step 3 |
| D5 Existing rows and objects | untouched; bucket limits apply to new uploads only | Q-0477 (forward-only) |
| D6 Kind vs type | no kind-to-type match in this ticket; `L` is the union of the Q-0513 (a) types over all kinds (order reports' PDF is already in it) | ticket row scope; Q-0513 (a) |
| D7 Global limit | `supabase/config.toml` and the two `scripts/*/scratch/supabase/config.toml` unchanged | D3 |

### Do not touch
`storage_sources_select`/`storage_sources_insert` policies, the `media` limits, `uploadFile`, `completeSourceFileUpload`, `sourceFilePath`, `SOURCE_FILE_KINDS`, every `supabase/config.toml`, the dev routes.

Ticket row: Scope: Q-0477 (rule 17, 18). EZD-290 limited `media`; `sources` still takes any file type and size from members, who also choose the served type. Types come from 03c-tables.md:15; the formats no source names and the size limit come to Josh when this ticket is planned (do not guess). A forward-only migration sets the bucket limits. / Done when: The `sources` bucket refuses a file whose type is not on the allowed list and a file over the size limit (test). A file of each allowed type is accepted (test). / Depends on: EZD-290 / Spec ref: Q-0477, rule 17, 18.

## 2. Sources
- `vault/spec/sections/03c-tables.md:15` (source_file kinds); `03b-architecture-rules.md` rule 1 (signed uploads straight to Storage).
- Q-0477 (QUESTIONS-answered.md:358): sources limit is its own ticket; unnamed formats and the size go to Josh.
- CLAUDE.md rules 17, 18 (close the class; design that cannot drift: the constant and the bucket row are compared in T1).
- R-052: IANA types `image/vnd.dxf`, `model/gltf-binary`, `application/pdf`, `image/heic`, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`; Storage matches exact then case-insensitive, ignores `;` parameters, `image/*` matches every image subtype; TUS reads `contentType` from Upload-Metadata at create; type and size are checked before the RLS insert on a standard upload (415 type, 413 size); bucket limit ≤ global; Free caps global at 50 MB, Pro up to 500 GB.
- Merged code: `supabase/migrations/20261102201341_set_media_bucket_limits.sql`, `app/src/server/storage/media-bucket.test.ts` (EZD-290 T6), `app/src/server/storage/source-files.ts`, `app/src/server/storage/storage.db.test.ts`, `app/src/lib/storage/upload.ts`, `supabase/config.toml:119`.

Architecture: Storage buckets and paths

## 3. Interface contract
| Kind | Name or path | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bucket | `sources` | `allowed_mime_types` = `L` (order as written), `file_size_limit` = `N` |
| export | `app/src/lib/storage/source-file-kinds.ts` | `SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES` (readonly tuple `L`), `type SourceContentType`, `SOURCE_MAX_BYTES: number` = `N` |
| export | `app/src/server/storage/source-files.ts` | `startSourceFileUpload` signature unchanged; a type not in `SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES` or `size > SOURCE_MAX_BYTES` throws `StorageError` code `invalid_input` |
| test file | `app/src/server/storage/sources-bucket.test.ts` | describe `EZD-296 sources bucket limits` |

## 4. Tests
File `sources-bucket.test.ts` (copy setup, `objectExists` and cleanup from `media-bucket.test.ts` with bucket `sources`; `db`, `caught` and `expectStorageCode` copied as local definitions from `storage.db.test.ts` lines 59–74, never imported from that file). `beforeAll`: `createTenant()`, `[p] = createProjects(t, 1)`, member `createMember({ tenantId: t, scope: 'all' })`, `signIn` → `s`; every call through `s.serverDb` (gated, EZD-024 lesson). A "pending row" = `startSourceFileUpload(db(s), { projectId: p, kind: 'pdf', originalName: 'plan.pdf', contentType: 'application/pdf', size: 100, uploadedBy: member.appUserId })`; its `storagePath` is pushed to the cleanup list. "Direct put" = `s.serverDb.storage.from('sources').upload(path, bytes, { contentType })`. Imports: `uploadFile`, `UploadError` from `../../lib/storage/upload`; `SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES`, `SOURCE_MAX_BYTES` from `../../lib/storage/source-file-kinds`; `startSourceFileUpload`, `completeSourceFileUpload`, `StorageError`, `type DbClient` from `./index`; fixtures from `../../../test-harness/rls/fixtures`. The start result is `{ sourceFile, upload }`; `uploadFile`'s first argument is that `upload` (`SignedUpload`), as `storage.db.test.ts:122`. Row count for T5 = `adminDb().from('source_file').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('project_id', p)` → `count`. Bytes are `new Uint8Array(k).fill(0x61)`; Storage does not read content (R-052). Timeout 120000 per test. Confirm on pinned version (L-009): before the build T1, T2, T3 and T5 fail (no bucket limit, no start check yet), T4 passes on the global limit and T6 passes; after Step 1, if the pinned Storage refuses a type of `L` in T6 or answers T2/T3 other than as written, the builder returns PLAN-GAP; nobody edits the test to pass.

| Test | AC | Type | Input | Expected value | Source of the expected value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 bucket row | 296-1 | unit (db) | `harnessSql` `select file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types from storage.buckets where id = 'sources'` | 1 row; `Number(file_size_limit)` = 52428800 = `SOURCE_MAX_BYTES`; `allowed_mime_types` `toEqual` `L` and `[...SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPES]` | Step 1, 2; D1, D3 |
| T2 wrong type, direct | 296-1 | unit (db) | pending row; direct put 100 bytes with each of `text/html`, `image/svg+xml`, `text/html; charset=utf-8`, `application/octet-stream`; then, same path, `application/pdf` | each refused: `error` not null and `objectExists` false; the control put `error` null, object exists | D1, D2; R-052 (params ignored, svg is an image subtype) |
| T3 wrong type, TUS | 296-1 | unit (db) | pending row; `uploadFile(upload, new Blob([bytes100]), { contentType: 'text/html' })`; then same `upload`, `{ contentType: 'application/pdf' }`, then `completeSourceFileUpload` | first rejects `UploadError` code `upload_rejected`, object absent; control resolves, `uploadedAt` not null | `upload.ts:124`; R-052 (TUS checks type at create) |
| T4 over size, direct | 296-1 | unit (db) | pending row; direct put `N + 1` = 52,428,801 bytes, `application/pdf`; then same path 100 bytes | first `error` not null, object absent; control `error` null, object exists; with Q-0514 (a) the global limit refuses this too, so T1 alone proves the bucket value | D3; R-052 |
| T5 start refuses | 296-1 | unit (db) | `startSourceFileUpload` with `contentType: 'text/html'`; with `'image/svg+xml'`; with `size: 52428801`; then `size: 52428800`, `contentType: 'APPLICATION/PDF'` | first three `invalid_input` and no new `source_file` row for the project (`adminDb` count unchanged); last resolves with `contentType` `application/pdf`, `sizeBytes` 52428800 | Step 3; D4 |
| T6 each type accepted | 296-2 | unit (db) | for each type of `L` (literal list): start (`kind: 'pdf'`, `originalName: 'f'`, `size: 16`, that `contentType`; D6), `uploadFile` 16 bytes with that type, `completeSourceFileUpload` | each: no throw, `uploadedAt` not null, `contentType` equals the type, object exists | D1 |

Existing test edit (test-author; R-052: the type check now answers before RLS, and supabase-js sends `text/plain;charset=UTF-8` when no type is given):
| # | File | Change | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | `app/src/server/storage/storage.db.test.ts` T14 lines 344–345 | `bucket.upload(path, y, { upsert: true, contentType: PDF })` and `bucket.update(path, y, { contentType: PDF })`; both still expect `RLS_REFUSED` | R-052; L-021 (EZD-021) |

All other existing `sources` uploads use `application/pdf` at ≤ 7,340,155 bytes (`storage.db.test.ts`, `app/e2e/storage.spec.ts:55`, `route-permission.test.ts:65`) and stay green.

## 5. Visual checklist
None.

## 6. Proposed wording
None (no screen; the dev route already answers `error.invalid_input`).

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: migrations, data access (Storage bucket limits, upload input check).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer yes · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
medium: small and on an existing pattern, but it changes a Storage security limit and an upload check that existing tests pin. Test-author Sonnet 5.5 / medium; builder Sonnet 5.5 / medium.

## 9. Dependencies
EZD-290 (row; merged `media` limits pattern). Missing from the row: EZD-132 (`sources` bucket, policies, `startSourceFileUpload`; merged). No browser harness (no screen).
Risks: a restore (EZD-025 `scripts/backup/scratch.mjs` `uploadFiles`) of a `sources` object stored before this migration with a type outside `L` would now fail; no production writer of `sources` exists yet (only the dev route, 404 in production, `app/src/app/api/dev/storage/route.ts:2`). With answer Q-0514 (a) T4 also passes on the global limit alone; T1 is the check of the bucket value.

## 10. Open questions
All answered (Josh 2026-11-03, `vault/questions/phase-01-for-josh.md` section 1, "Accept all"): Q-0513 (a), Q-0514 (a). No value in sections 1, 3 or 4 changed.
- Q-0513, answered (a): No source names the file format for the kinds `image`, `photo`, `panel_photo`, `order_report` and `field_measure` (03c-tables.md:15; the planner's read list has none), so which types may the `sources` bucket take besides DXF (`image/vnd.dxf`), Polycam GLB (`model/gltf-binary`) and PDF (`application/pdf`)? Options: (a) photos and images JPEG, PNG and HEIC (the iPhone camera format; browsers other than Safari cannot show HEIC, so a later ticket converts it), order reports PDF only, field measure files the same photo types (recommended); (b) (a) without HEIC (phones must send JPEG); (c) (a) plus WebP and CSV/Excel order reports; (d) Josh names them.
- Q-0514, answered (a): What is the largest single file `sources` takes (the largest Polycam scan, PDF set or DXF Josh imports)? Options: (a) 50 MiB, 52,428,800 bytes, today's project-wide cap, with no setting or billing change (recommended until an import ticket finds a bigger file); (b) a larger number Josh names, which also needs the hosted project's global upload limit raised (Supabase Pro plan or above; Free caps at 50 MB, R-052) and the global limit in `supabase/config.toml` and both `scripts/*/scratch/supabase/config.toml` (outside the builder's files) raised to match.

# EZD-297 · Fix: the realtime event tests in realtime-auth, the job runner and notification T3 wait for their events

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-297-1, AC-EZD-297-2
- **Complexity:** medium (section 8)
- **Areas:** testing, realtime
- **User-visible result:** none in the app; the live-update tests stop failing at random, so a red gate means a real fault.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-02 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Test-only. Every file is a test or `test-harness/` file, so the test-author writes all of them and there is no builder step (CLAUDE.md rule 5; EZD-291 STATUS note "no builder"). Names: H = `app/test-harness/realtime/stream.ts`; RA = `app/src/server/realtime/realtime-auth.test.ts`; JR = `app/src/server/jobs/runner.test.ts`; NT = `app/src/server/notifications/notification.db.test.ts`.

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | H | change | add `probeTarget`, `sendTopicProbe`, `windowBetween`, `nonProbeEvents`; `StreamContext` loses `appUserId`; `FencedStepResult` gains `window` (section 3). `ensureStream` and `fencedStep` call `sendTopicProbe(sql, channel.topic)` where they now call `sendProbe(sql, appUserId)`. `eventsBetween` returns `windowBetween(...)` filtered by name (`null` when it is `null`). | H itself (`sendProbe`, `eventsBetween`) | `pnpm run typecheck` |
| 2 | `app/test-harness/realtime/stream.test.ts` | change | new top-level `describe('EZD-297 stream helpers')`, tests S1–S4 | the file's EZD-291 describe | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/app exec vitest run test-harness/realtime/stream.test.ts` |
| 3 | `app/src/server/permissions/permissions.db.test.ts` | change | D5 and D5c `fencedStep` calls drop the `appUserId` key; nothing else changes | — | P1 |
| 4 | RA | change | tests R1–R6 | D5 in step 3's file | V1 |
| 5 | JR | change | tests J1–J2 | D5 | V1 |
| 6 | NT | change | tests N1–N2 | D5 | V1 |

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Why fence | A probe on the channel's topic before the step proves the stream live; one after it fences the step (one topic arrives in commit order) | H header; R-048 |
| Probe topic | Always `channel.topic`. `user:<id>` → `private.broadcast_user(id, 'test.probe', jsonb_build_object('probe', nonce))` (the current `sendProbe` call). `project:<id>` → the same through `private.broadcast_project`. `test.probe` matches the event-name check `^[a-z][a-z_]*\.[a-z][a-z_]*$` | `supabase/migrations/20261022120002_create_realtime_broadcast_functions.sql` lines 15, 31 |
| `probeTarget` | Match `^(user\|project):([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$`; anything else → `null`. `sendTopicProbe` throws `Error('realtime_probe_topic')` on `null` before any SQL | architecture "Realtime (EZD-018)" Topics (lower-case canonical UUIDs) |
| `appUserId` | Removed from `StreamContext` (the topic carries the id); `fencedStep` opts stay `StreamContext & { event; restore?; run }`; drop the `appUserId` destructure in `ensureStream` (H line 94) and `fencedStep` (line 116). Step 3 drops the key (an extra literal key fails typecheck) | step 1 |
| Positive checks | Assert on `arrived` (the step's named events) or `window` (all events between the probes), never on a channel's whole `events` list: a repeated step may leave a first-try event outside the window | EZD-291 D5 (`arrived`) |
| Negative check, joined channel | After the steps, `await ensureStream(<ctx for that channel>)`, then assert the named count on its whole `events` is 0. No fixed wait | H (commit order per topic) |
| Negative check, refused channel | Keep `await sleep(QUIET_MS)` after the fenced step, then the existing asserts. It cannot receive a probe; the fence on the joined channel already proved the stream carried the event | EZD-018 plan Tests intro ("receives nothing" = 3,000 ms after the send) |
| Removed waits | Every `waitFor(...)` that waits for an event and every `sleep(QUIET_MS)` before a positive check in R1–R3, R5, J1, N1 goes (R4 keeps its presence `waitFor` and its `sleep(QUIET_MS)`: no database event there); the leading `sleep(QUIET_MS)` after joins in NT T3 goes. `sleep(20)` in JR and `sleep(1100)` in NT stay | Q-0479; Q-0486 |
| Context | `{ sql: harnessSql(), channel, accessToken }`; `accessToken` is the token that joined `channel` | H `ensureStream` (re-join with it) |
| Control setup | R6: `createMember({ tenantId: tenantA, scope: 'listed', listed: [p1] })` + `signIn` (RA line 79); `p1`, `p2` are the file's two `beforeAll` projects (RA 65–68). J2: `createMember({ tenantId: tenantA, scope: 'all' })` + `signIn` (JR 173–177). N2: `f = await track()`, `own` = `connectRealtime(f.mS.accessToken)` joining `user:${f.m.appUserId}` (NT 230–235). J1 step B row: `insertJob({ payload: { steps: 1, stepMs: 0 } })` (JR 215; no `project_id`) | existing setup lines |
| Repeated step state | A value made inside `run` (job id, notification id) goes into a `let` declared before the call and is read after it, so the asserts see the last attempt's id | H `fencedStep` (run may run twice) |
| Restores | NT step 2: `update public.notification set read_at = null where id = <n1>`; NT step 4: the same for `<n2>`. RA T23: `update public.membership set status = 'active' where id = <d.membershipId>`. Restores run before each attempt's start probe, so their own events (T23 re-activation sends `session.ended`) fall outside the window | `open_notification` broadcasts only when `read_at` is null and `mark_all_notifications_read` only when it changed rows (`20261102210539_create_notification_functions.sql` 179, 240); end-sessions trigger on status change (`20261026112732_…` line 10); H runs `restore` first |
| T23 after deactivation | The end probe still reaches `own`: `session.ended` is committed in the same transaction as the deactivation and already reaches the joined channel today | RA T23 (passing on develop) |
| Test placement | Controls go inside each file's existing top-level `describe`, titles starting `EZD-297 control:`, timeout 60000 (D5c precedent). Existing titles do not change | permissions.db.test.ts D5c; architecture "Test scope (Q-0006)" |
| Imports | Remove each import a file no longer uses (`QUIET_MS`, `waitFor`, `JOIN_WAIT_MS`, `sleep` where unused) | `pnpm run lint` |
| Timeouts | RA `LONG` and NT 120000 stay; J1, J2 get 60000 (J1 has 5 probe waits of up to 10,000 ms) | `app/vitest.config.mts` 15000; H `JOIN_WAIT_MS` |

## 1. What to build

### Build steps

| E1 | `scripts/conventions/__tests__/docs-truth.test.mjs` | change (test-author) | none | itself | `node --test scripts/conventions/__tests__/docs-truth.test.mjs` passes after B1 |
| B1 | `supabase/migrations/20261020101101_create_unconfirmed_password_guard.sql` | change (builder) | none | none (restore). Run exactly `git restore --source=5feb8acc622625db29cb2b42cd0faacbd7c71d04 -- supabase/migrations/20261020101101_create_unconfirmed_password_guard.sql` in the worktree (`5feb8acc…` is `54bb4d44^`, a fixed commit on `develop` whose copy of the file is the blob above) | T1 passes; `git diff 5feb8acc622625db29cb2b42cd0faacbd7c71d04 -- <file>` prints nothing |
| B2 | `docs/architecture.md` | change (builder) | none | itself | `grep -cF 'and this bullet is the correct note (EZD-298).' docs/architecture.md` prints `1`, and `grep -n 'Unconfirmed-password guard' docs/architecture.md` shows that text on the same line; then `node --test scripts/conventions/__tests__/*.test.mjs scripts/db/__tests__/auth-config.test.mjs scripts/db/__tests__/link-migrations.test.mjs` passes. The code-reviewer re-checks this (Q-0515 (a)) |

E1 edits, all three, nothing else in the file:
1. Delete the whole test `it('EZD-160 T8 guard migration comment matches the stack', …)` (lines 109-125). It asserts the two edited comment lines, so it fails once B1 restores the released text, and it reads a comment's wording (L-041). Append exactly one sentence at the end of that bullet, after `(Q-0095).`, separated by one space:
`The header comment of \`supabase/migrations/20261020101101_create_unconfirmed_password_guard.sql\` still says the pinned Auth stores null for a user without a password; that file is on \`main\` (Release run 40086272055, 2026-10-24), so it is never edited (\`### Release safety (EZD-023a)\` M2) and this bullet is the correct note (EZD-298).`

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-300-1
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** ci, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** CI's checkout drops the token; a workflow keeping it fails a test.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-02 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
`ci.yml` is guarded (guard-paths.mjs:102): Josh applies step 1 before the build (PROCESS.md:334 hold; EZD-284 precedent, 259a1613). No builder.

### Build steps

| 1 | `vault/handoff/ezd-300-ci-persist.patch` (orchestrator writes; Josh applies) | new: after `ci.yml` line 23 add `        with:` and `          persist-credentials: false` (8 and 10 spaces) | none | `vault/handoff/ezd-284-ci-pin.patch`; `backup-db.yml` lines 22-24 | `git apply --check` |
| 2 | `scripts/ci/__tests__/ci.test.mjs` (test-author) | change: section 3 helper after `pnpmPinProblems`; section 4 test at file end | none exported | `pnpmPinProblems`; EZD-284 test block | `node --test --test-name-pattern EZD-300 scripts/ci/__tests__/ci.test.mjs` |

### Decided for the builder

# EZD-318 · Fix: the realtime hub resyncs on a subscriber's first join and after a refused token

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-318-1, AC-EZD-318-2, AC-EZD-318-3
- **Complexity:** medium
- **Areas:** realtime, testing
- **User-visible result:** a change made while a page is still connecting (a permission switch, later a notification) shows up without a reload, also after the first connection attempt failed.
- Phase: 2 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-03 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build

Data: none (no table, migration or policy).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `app/src/lib/realtime/hub.ts` | change | Exports unchanged except `ChannelHandle.ready` becomes `readonly ready: Promise<'subscribed' \| 'refused'>`. Internal: `Entry.settle` renamed `resolve`; new `Entry.outcome: 'subscribed' \| 'refused' \| null` (start `null`); new `Callbacks.synced: boolean` (start `false`); new `settleReady(e: Entry, v: 'subscribed' \| 'refused'): void`; new `runResync(h: Callbacks): void`; the handle's `ready` becomes a getter `get ready() { return entry.ready; }` | the file itself (`setStatus`, `refuse`) | `pnpm --dir app exec vitest run src/lib/realtime/hub.test.ts` |
| 2 | `docs/architecture.md` | change: `### Realtime (EZD-018)`, the `**Resync.**` bullet only | none | the bullet it replaces | `node --test scripts/db/__tests__/realtime-sql.test.mjs` (EZD-018 T20 still finds the heading and its terms) |

Step 1 detail (D-rows below give the source of each):
1. `settleReady(e, v)`: if `e.outcome === v` return; if `e.outcome === null` call `e.resolve(v)`, else set `e.ready = Promise.resolve(v)`; then `e.outcome = v`. Every current `e.settle(x)` call (in `refuse`, `tokenFailed`, `onJoinStatus`, `endSession`, `refuseInvalid`) becomes `settleReady(e, x)`.
2. `runResync(h)`: `h.synced = true`, then `for (const cb of [...h.resync]) void cb();`.
3. `onJoinStatus`, `SUBSCRIBED` branch: delete `const resync = e.everSubscribed;`; keep `e.everSubscribed = true`, `e.errors = 0`, `setStatus(e, 'subscribed')`, then `settleReady(e, 'subscribed')`, keep the `track` line, then `for (const h of [...e.handles]) runResync(h);` (no condition).
4. `tokenFailed`: the loop skips an entry when `e.refused || e.status === 'subscribed'`; for the others `setStatus(e, 'refused')` and `settleReady(e, 'refused')`.
5. `acquire`: after `let released = false;`, add `void Promise.resolve().then(() => { if (released || ended || cbs.synced || entry.status !== 'subscribed') return; runResync(cbs); });`.
6. File header comment, lines 3-4: "every onResync callback runs exactly once after each re-subscription" becomes "every handle's onResync callbacks run exactly once after each SUBSCRIBED, the first included, and once when a handle joins a channel already subscribed (EZD-318)".

Step 2 text, replacing the whole `**Resync.**` bullet:
"- **Resync.** Every `SUBSCRIBED` of a channel, the first one included, calls every `onResync` callback of every handle on it exactly once, so each subscriber refetches once per join: a change made between the server render and the first join, or while the channel was down or its token refused, is picked up (EZD-318; Q-0545, Q-0546). A handle taken on a channel that is already subscribed has its callbacks called once on the next microtask; a callback added to a handle after that handle's resync waits for the next `SUBSCRIBED`. After a drop (channel error, timeout, unexpected close, socket close) the status is `reconnecting`; on the next socket open, or when `useOnline`'s source reports online, the hub fetches a token once and rejoins. A refused token fetch sets `refused` on every channel not subscribed (a subscribed one is left as it is) and the next socket open or online report retries. `ready` always holds a channel's latest outcome: pending until the first, then a promise resolved `'subscribed'` or `'refused'`, replaced when the outcome changes."

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Which SUBSCRIBED resyncs | Every one, the first included; "the first subscription calls none" is removed. Exactly once per SUBSCRIBED per callback. | Q-0545, Q-0546 answers; phase-02.md EZD-318 Scope; AC-EZD-318-1, -3 |
| D2 Resync after a refused token | Covered by D1: the reconnect's first SUBSCRIBED calls every callback once; `everSubscribed` no longer gates resync (it still gates the `reconnecting` status in `onJoinError` and `onSocketClose`, unchanged). | Q-0546 (hub.ts:154-161, 207-216); AC-EZD-318-2 |
| D3 How `ready` settles again | `settleReady` (step 1.1); the handle reads `entry.ready` through a getter, so a read after the change sees the new promise. A caller that awaited the old promise keeps the old answer. | Q-0546 "ready cannot settle again"; AC-EZD-318-2 |
| D4 `ready` after `session.ended` | `settleReady(e, 'refused')` on every entry: a subscribed handle's `ready` becomes resolved `'refused'`, matching its `closed` status. | D3 (one rule, no exception); EZD-018 Step 5 item 8 (pending ready resolves `'refused'`) |
| D5 Handle taken on a channel already subscribed | One resync of that handle's callbacks on the next microtask (step 1.5); none if released first, the session ended, or the channel is not `subscribed` then (it gets D1's resync at the next SUBSCRIBED instead). Other handles get none. | ticket title "a subscriber's first join"; Q-0545 "same class"; CLAUDE.md rule 18 |
| D6 Token refresh fails while some channels are subscribed | `tokenFailed` leaves `subscribed` entries alone (step 1.4); today it marks a healthy channel `refused` while it still receives. | Q-0546 (same function, refused-token path); CLAUDE.md rule 18 |
| D7 Refused join | Unchanged: a join refused twice is `refused` (`e.refused`), removed, never retried. | EZD-018 Step 5 item 4; ARCH Realtime "Requests only on events" |
| D8 Requests | No new token fetch, timer or channel: resync only calls callbacks. | ARCH Realtime "Requests only on events"; 11 rule 11 |
| D9 Callback errors | Unchanged: `void cb()`; the hub does not catch. | hub.ts:216 |

### Do not touch
`adapter.ts`, `events.ts`, `topics.ts`, `index.ts`, `react.ts`; every consumer (`PermissionsProvider.tsx`, `watch-job.ts`, dev probes); `app/test-harness/realtime/fake-adapter.ts`; in `docs/architecture.md` every line but the Resync bullet, including the `### Realtime (EZD-018)` heading and the terms EZD-018 T20 checks (`project:`, `user:`, `private.broadcast_project`, `private.broadcast_user`, `/api/realtime/token`).

Ticket row: `vault/tickets/phases/phase-02.md` EZD-318.

## 2. Sources

Architecture: Realtime (EZD-018)

## 3. Interface contract

## 4. Tests

N1, N2, N4 build their own hub with `createRealtimeHub({ fetchToken, adapter: createFakeAdapter(), env: { online: createOnlineSource(target, nav) }, onSessionEnded: vi.fn() })` (pattern: `setup()`), because `setup()`'s fetchToken cannot hold or reject.

| T14 edit (EZD-018) | 3 | unit | unchanged | `r1`, `r2` each `2` (was 1: one for the first join, one after the error) | D1 |

None (no screen changes).

None.

security-review: no (no table, policy, route, permission check or token handling changes; permissions are still checked by the server, the browser set only hides controls, Q-0214).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

Medium: a small diff, but in shared asynchronous state that three consumers rely on, with five existing tests to re-check. Test-author Sonnet 5.5 / medium; builder Sonnet 5.5 / medium (PROCESS.md section 4).

## 9. Dependencies
- EZD-018 (done): the hub and its tests. EZD-102 (done, not in the ticket row): its B4 browser test changes value (section 4); EZD-102 is merged, so no ordering issue. EZD-016a (done) only for the browser harness (B4, B7).
- Downstream: EZD-110b resumes after this merges (handoff); its plan should be re-validated against D1, D3 and D5.

None.

# EZD-319 · Fix: the my-profile migration runs after every migration already on the dev database

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-319-1, AC-EZD-319-2
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** migrations, ci, testing
- **User-visible result:** none on screen; the cloud dev database (used by preview deploys) gets My profile's two database functions again, and every later dev migration push works.
- Phase: 2 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-03 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Data: no schema change. One migration file is renamed so that its version is newer than every version already applied on `ezdraft-dev`. Its bytes stay identical (ticket Scope: "with no change to its SQL").

Facts the plan rests on (checked 2026-11-03):
- F1. The dev push failed: `supabase db push` refused `supabase/migrations/20261030205252_create_my_profile_functions.sql` as "to be inserted before the last migration on remote database" (run 41756259716 log).
- F2. The newest version applied on `ezdraft-dev` is `20261103180000`. Run 41704119291 (EZD-296) logged `applied migration: 20261103180000_set_sources_bucket_limits.sql`; the next run, 41747822879 (EZD-298), logged `dev migration push done: 0 migration(s)`; the next one is F1.
- F3. The newest file on develop (c0666d52) is `20261103180000_set_sources_bucket_limits.sql`. No worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` holds a migration that is missing from develop.
- F4. None of the six later migrations (`20261102201341` … `20261103180000`) names `update_my_profile`, `current_user_has_password` or `my_profile` (grep). So running the file after them changes no object they define. What it needs (`public.app_user`, `private.require_api_gate`, `private.app_user_id`, `auth.users`) comes from older migrations.
- F5. There are no `phase-*` release tags, local or on `origin` (`git ls-remote --tags`). So the release check's M2 (released migration removed) and M3 (version not newer than the newest released) cannot fire (`scripts/release/check-migrations.mjs` lines 136–166).
- F6. No app, script or test file names the old file or its suffix. Tests that need the newest version compute it from the folder (`app/src/app/api/health/route.test.ts:24`, `scripts/db/__tests__/db.test.mjs:61`). Only `vault/plans/EZD-108.md:21` and the phase-02 row name the old file.
- F7. SHA-256 of the file at f8904f94 and on develop: `08918f6b065e739d11e48ec7dc42adbbb4ac3ad96b5a7bbb7687175be2fa5c21` (`shasum -a 256`).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `supabase/migrations/20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql` | rename by `git mv supabase/migrations/20261030205252_create_my_profile_functions.sql supabase/migrations/20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql`; no edit to the content | none | none (first rename of a merged migration; `git mv`, bytes unchanged) | `shasum -a 256 supabase/migrations/20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql` prints F7's hash; `git status` shows `renamed:` |
| 2 | (no file) local stack check | none | none | none | `pnpm db:up` exits 0, then `node scripts/db/gen-types.mjs --check` exits 0 (types unchanged: same functions) and `node --test scripts/db/__tests__/my-profile-migration.test.mjs` passes; then the gate `node scripts/gate.mjs .claude/worktrees/EZD-319` is green |
| 3 | `vault/plans/EZD-108.md` (orchestrator, after merge) | change line 21 only: replace `supabase/migrations/20261030205252_create_my_profile_functions.sql` with `supabase/migrations/20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql (renamed by EZD-319)` | none | none | `grep -c 20261030205252 vault/plans/EZD-108.md` prints `0` |
| 4 | (orchestrator, after merge) AC-EZD-319-2 | none | none | none | run `gh run list --workflow supabase-dev.yml --branch develop --limit 1` and `gh run view <id> --log`; the expected values are in section 4, T4 |

The test file `scripts/db/__tests__/my-profile-migration.test.mjs` is the test-author's (section 4). The builder does not edit it (CLAUDE.md rule 5).

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| New version | `20261103180001`: one second after develop's newest, `20261103180000` (F2, F3). Hand-picked sequential versions are already in use (`20261024100005`/`…06`, `20261103180000`). | ticket Scope; docs/architecture.md `## Migrations` (14-digit UTC, unique, C5) |
| Description part of the name | unchanged: `create_my_profile_functions` | ticket Scope ("rename it") |
| How to rename | `git mv`, so git records a rename and the content stays byte-identical, including the header comment that cites `vault/plans/EZD-108.md` | ticket Scope ("no change to its SQL"); T2 |
| `supabase db push --include-all` instead of a rename | no. Agents never run `db push` (docs/architecture.md `### Local database`, Cloud dev; `.claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs`), and `--include-all` would apply the file on dev in a different order than the repo lists it | ticket Scope |
| A migration with version ≥ `20261103180001` is on develop when the builder merges develop into the worktree | stop and report `PLAN-GAP` (T1 pins the name). Do not pick another version | lesson EZD-113 re-validation (new versions newer than develop's newest) |
| `app/src/server/db/database.types.ts` | not regenerated; step 2's `--check` must pass as it stands | F4 (no object changes) |
| `docs/architecture.md` | no change: no line names this file | F6 |
| Old version `20261030205252` on `ezdraft-dev` | none needed: the refused push applied nothing (F1), so dev never recorded `20261030205252` | run 41756259716 log |
| Debt D-037 (a gate check refusing a migration older than develop's newest) | not in this ticket; it stays on `vault/debt.md` | ticket Scope; CLAUDE.md rule 4 |

### Do not touch
- Every other file in `supabase/migrations/`, and the bytes of the renamed file.
- `scripts/test-harness/db-lock.test.mjs` (EZD-286's list `L` is an inclusion list, so a new file does not break it), `scripts/db/__tests__/db.test.mjs`, `scripts/db/dev-push.mjs`, `.github/workflows/supabase-dev.yml`, `scripts/conventions/check.mjs`, `scripts/gate.mjs`.
- `app/src/server/db/database.types.ts`, `docs/architecture.md`.

Ticket row (phase-02.md line 48):
- **Scope:** Rule 17 defect: the Supabase dev migrations workflow failed on EZD-108's merge (run 41756259716) because `supabase/migrations/20261030205252_create_my_profile_functions.sql` is older than migrations already applied on the dev database, so `supabase db push` refuses it and every later dev push fails too. Rename it to a timestamp after the newest migration on develop, with no change to its SQL, and update the reference in `vault/plans/EZD-108.md` if the plan allows.
- **Done when:** The local stack builds from all migrations with the renamed file (test). The Supabase dev migrations workflow passes on develop after the merge (CI run).
- **Depends on:** EZD-108
- **Spec ref:** CI run 41756259716, rules 17, 18 (spec 11 Non-functional · Operations)

## 2. Sources
- Spec: `vault/spec/sections/11-non-functional-requirements.md` **Operations**: the environments are local, dev (preview deploys use the dev database) and production; migrations add before they remove. No decision file applies (`--reads` lists none). No Q-ID applies.
- CLAUDE.md rules 17 (defect at the front of the queue) and 18 (build for the long term).
- CI runs: 41756259716 (the failure), 41704119291 (the last applied version), 41747822879 (0 pending), all on `supabase-dev.yml` on develop (`gh run view`, 2026-11-03).
- Code: `scripts/db/dev-push.mjs` (output lines `applied migration: <name>` and `dev migration push done: <n> migration(s)`), `scripts/release/push.mjs` `parsePendingMigrations`, `scripts/release/check-migrations.mjs` (M2, M3), `scripts/db/sql.mjs` `runLocalSql`, `scripts/test-harness/db-lock.mjs` `holdRootDbShared`, `scripts/backup/__tests__/local-fixture.mjs` `inScope`, `scripts/db/__tests__/types-check.test.mjs` (the lock and scope pattern), and `supabase/migrations/20261030205252_create_my_profile_functions.sql` (lines 57–58 and 76–77: the grants).
- EZD-108 interface contract (`vault/plans/EZD-108.md` section 3): `public.update_my_profile(text, text)` and `public.current_user_has_password()`. This plan keeps both unchanged.
- Lessons applied: L-041 (no test reads a document), L-009 (the SQL in T3 was run on the pinned local stack on 2026-11-03 and printed `20261030205252` / `t|t` / `t|f|t|f` / `text`, with the old version still applied), EZD-113 re-validation (the new version is newer than develop's newest), EZD-015a (inventories: the EZD-286 list `L` is not exhaustive; no edit).
- Research: no R-NNN report covers this ticket.

Architecture: Migrations; Local database

## 3. Interface contract
| Kind | Name or path | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| file | `supabase/migrations/20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql` | the only file in the folder ending `_create_my_profile_functions.sql`; SHA-256 equals F7's hash |
| file (absent) | `supabase/migrations/20261030205252_create_my_profile_functions.sql` | does not exist |
| file | `scripts/db/__tests__/my-profile-migration.test.mjs` | node:test, Node 22 built-ins plus `runLocalSql` from `../sql.mjs`, `holdRootDbShared` from `../../test-harness/db-lock.mjs` and `inScope` from `../../backup/__tests__/local-fixture.mjs`; no exports |
| SQL (unchanged) | `public.update_my_profile(text, text)`, `public.current_user_has_password()` | as in EZD-108 section 3; `authenticated` may execute both, `anon` may execute neither |
| CI output | `.github/workflows/supabase-dev.yml` run on develop | log line `applied migration: 20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql`; conclusion `success` |

## 4. Tests
Written by the test-author before any code, in `scripts/db/__tests__/my-profile-migration.test.mjs`. T1 and T2 sit in `describe('EZD-319 my-profile migration file', …)` and need no Docker. T3 sits in `describe('EZD-319 my-profile migration on the local stack', { skip: !inScope('EZD-319') }, …)`, which takes `holdRootDbShared()` in `before` and releases it in `after` (docs/architecture.md `## Tests`; pattern `scripts/db/__tests__/types-check.test.mjs` lines 160–163). Each title starts with `EZD-319 T<n>`. The root `test` script runs `pnpm db:up` first, so T3 sees a freshly reset stack (docs/architecture.md `### Local database`). Before the rename, T1, T2 and T3 fail.

| Test | AC | Type (unit / browser / perf) | Input | Expected value | Source of the expected value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 EZD-319 T1 the my-profile migration is renamed past dev's newest version, done when | AC-EZD-319-1 | unit (node:test, fs) | `readdirSync('supabase/migrations')` | (a) the files ending `_create_my_profile_functions.sql` deep-equal `['20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql']`; (b) `20261030205252_create_my_profile_functions.sql` is absent; (c) the file's first 14 characters, compared as strings, are greater than `'20261103180000'` | (a) section 1 Decided "New version"; (b) ticket Scope; (c) F2: run 41704119291 log |
| T2 EZD-319 T2 the renamed file's bytes are unchanged | AC-EZD-319-1 | unit (node:test, `node:crypto` `createHash('sha256')` over the raw `readFileSync` Buffer) | `supabase/migrations/20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql` | hex digest `08918f6b065e739d11e48ec7dc42adbbb4ac3ad96b5a7bbb7687175be2fa5c21` | F7: `shasum -a 256` of the file at f8904f94, 2026-11-03; ticket Scope "no change to its SQL" |
| T3 EZD-319 T3 the local stack builds from all migrations with the renamed file, done when | AC-EZD-319-1 | unit (node:test, Docker; one `runLocalSql` call) | SQL, three statements: `select version from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version in ('20261030205252', '20261103180001') order by version;` then `select to_regprocedure('public.update_my_profile(text,text)') is not null, to_regprocedure('public.current_user_has_password()') is not null;` then `select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.update_my_profile(text,text)', 'execute'), has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.update_my_profile(text,text)', 'execute'), has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.current_user_has_password()', 'execute'), has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.current_user_has_password()', 'execute');` | `code` `0`; `stdout` strictly equal to `'20261103180001\nt|t\nt|f|t|f\n'` | version: section 1 Decided; functions: EZD-108 section 3; privileges: migration lines 57–58 and 76–77 (revoke from public, anon and service_role; grant to authenticated); format: `runLocalSql` passes `-t -A` (`scripts/db/sql.mjs:25`), probed on the pinned stack on 2026-11-03 (section 2) |
| T4 (orchestrator check, not a test file) | AC-EZD-319-2 | CI run | after merge: `gh run list --workflow supabase-dev.yml --branch develop --limit 1`, `gh run view <id> --log` | the run's head commit is the EZD-319 merge commit; it ends `completed success`; the log contains `applied migration: 20261103180001_create_my_profile_functions.sql`; the orchestrator writes the run ID in the STATUS note. A failure is a defect ticket (CLAUDE.md rule 17) | `scripts/db/dev-push.mjs` output lines; format as in run 41704119291 |

EZD-004a T1 (`scripts/db/__tests__/db.test.mjs`: the applied versions equal the files) keeps passing unedited and also covers AC-EZD-319-1. No earlier test needs an edit (F6).

## 5. Visual checklist
None.

## 6. Proposed wording
None.

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: migrations. The renamed file creates two `security definer` functions and their grants. T2 proves the bytes are unchanged and T3 proves the grants on the stack. The gate flags `migrations` and `db/` (`scripts/gate.mjs` `SECURITY_PATHS`).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
Low: one `git mv`, one test file in an existing pattern, a complete contract, and no new object, permission or calculation. Test-author: Haiku 5.5 / high. Builder: Haiku 5.5 / high (PROCESS.md section 4).

## 9. Dependencies
- EZD-108 (done, f8904f94). No dependency is missing from the ticket row; EZD-016a is not needed (no visual checklist).
- Risks:
  - The dev push stays broken for every develop merge until this ticket merges, so it should go first in the queue (rule 17).

## 10. Open questions
None.

# EZD-320 · Fix: a project member cannot complete or orphan another person's pending source-file upload

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-320-1, AC-EZD-320-2
- **Complexity:** high
- **Areas:** migrations, security, data-model, testing
- **User-visible result:** only the person who started a file upload can finish it, and nobody can erase who uploaded a file; removing a user still works.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-03 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Data: no new table, column or money field; `schema_version` unchanged. One forward-only migration replaces policy `source_file_update` and function `private.source_file_keep_original()`; the released migration is not edited (ticket row). Grants unchanged (TABLE_GRANTS, EZD-132 section 3).

Step 4 sentence, appended at the bullet's end: "A pending row (`uploaded_at` null) is updated only by its starter (`source_file_update`); `uploaded_by` changes only to null when its `app_user` row is gone (`on delete set null`); stamping `uploaded_at` needs the `sources` object with the row's path and size (EZD-320)."

# EZD-321 · Fix: every cap that counts rows before inserting takes a lock first

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-321-1, AC-EZD-321-2
- **Complexity:** medium
- **Areas:** migrations, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** none on screen; error bursts stay within 100 rows an hour; a check blocks future limits that count without a lock.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-03 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Data: one migration redefining `public.record_error_alert` (D1). Of six counting functions only it lacks a lock (C1).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `supabase/migrations/<ts>_error_alert_row_cap_lock.sql` (D2) | new | SQL `public.record_error_alert(text, text, text, text, text, uuid, uuid)`; signature, returns, volatility, definer, `search_path`, grants unchanged (EZD-143 section 3) | `20261027001745_guard_gated_rpcs.sql` lines 158-256 copied whole, with its `revoke all … from public, anon, service_role` and `grant execute … to anon, authenticated, service_role` (L-016), plus D1 | `pnpm db:up`; R1-R3 |
| 2 | `app/test-harness/rls/cap-locks.ts` | new | section 3 | allow-list: `app/test-harness/rls/private-execute.ts`; `fn` format: `app/test-harness/rls/audit.ts` line 83; lexer: `scripts/release/sql-scan.mjs` lines 27-140 ported to TypeScript (D4) | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/app exec vitest run src/server/db/cap-locks.db.test.ts` |
| 3 | `docs/architecture.md` | change | none | D7 | `node scripts/conventions/check.mjs` |

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Lock | Inside `if not v_runner then`, after `v_project := null;`, before `if not exists (…fingerprint…)`: `perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('error_alert_row_cap:' \|\| case when p_source = 'function' then 'function' else 'browser_worker' end, 0));`. One key per source group; placed before the fingerprint check so same-fingerprint first calls serialise too. Rest byte-identical. Lock order row-cap key, fingerprint row, email lock: no deadlock. | ticket Scope; `20261027001745` lines 192-204, 220; `20261023130001` line 35 (key pattern) |
| D2 Migration name | `<ts>` = `date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S` at build time, sorting after the newest file in `supabase/migrations/`. First line: `-- EZD-321 (vault/plans/EZD-321.md D1): the record_error_alert row cap locks before counting.` | architecture Migrations; lesson EZD-113; EZD-298 |
| D3 Lexer | Tokens as `sql-scan.mjs`: whitespace; `--` comment to newline; nested `/* */`; `'…'` with `''`; `E'…'` with `\` escapes (not after a word character); `"…"` with `""`; `$tag$…$tag$` (`$1` is no quote); word; other. Any unterminated comment, string, identifier or dollar quote = unreadable. Two texts of the input's exact length: **count text** = comments as spaces, a quoted identifier with value `count` (7 characters `"count"`) as the 7 characters ` count `, rest as written; **lock text** = count text with every string, dollar-quoted and quoted-identifier token also as spaces. | lesson EZD-153; `sql-scan.mjs` lines 27-140 |
| D4 Rules | COUNT = `/\bcount\s*\(/i` on count text (strings kept, so dynamic SQL counts). LOCK = `/\bpg_advisory_xact_lock\s*\(\|\block\s+table\b\|\bfor\s+(?:no\s+key\s+)?update\b/i` on lock text (session, `_shared` and `try_` forms are no lock). Per function, in order: unreadable → `unreadable_body`, stop; no COUNT → not a counter; listed in `readOnly` → `listed_counter_volatile` when volatility `v`, else nothing; unlisted → `count_without_lock` unless a LOCK match starts before the first COUNT match. `readOnly` entry with no counting function of that `fn` → `stale_read_only_counter`. Per policy: `qual` or `withCheck` unreadable → `unreadable_body`; COUNT, or `/\b<name>\s*\(/i` for any counting function's `name`, in either → `policy_counts`. One problem per (fn, code), sorted by `fn` then `code`. So a cap is `count(…)` in a volatile function, after its lock. | ticket Scope; CLAUDE.md rule 18 (a policy cap cannot lock) |
| D5 `CAP_LOCK_READ_ONLY` | In order: `private.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb)` reason `Token claim; stable (20261019170004).`; `public.list_customers(text, boolean, integer)` reason `Customers list totals; stable (20261026233829).`; `public.list_notifications(timestamp with time zone, uuid)` reason `Notifications list counts; stable (20261102210539).` (non-volatile: PostgreSQL refuses writes). | planning probe of `pg_proc` |
| D6 Catalog read | Functions: `select format('%I.%I(%s)', n.nspname, p.proname, oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)) as fn, p.proname::text as name, p.provolatile::text as volatility, p.prosrc as body from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public', 'private') and p.prokind in ('f', 'p') and not exists (select 1 from pg_depend d where d.classid = 'pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid = p.oid and d.deptype = 'e') order by 1`. Policies, all schemas: `select format('policy %I.%I %I', schemaname, tablename, policyname) as policy, coalesce(qual, '') as qual, coalesce(with_check, '') as with_check from pg_policies order by 1`; `with_check` → `withCheck`. | `audit.ts` line 83; planning probe |
| D7 Docs | (a) Migrations, new bullet: `- A function that counts rows for a cap locks (D4 forms) before its first count(…); no policy counts. Read-only counters: app/test-harness/rls/cap-locks.ts (EZD-321).` (b) Errors and logging, `error_alert` bullet: after `100 from function (EZD-143)` insert `, each group counted under its own transaction lock (EZD-321)`. (c) Machine checks, after the EZD-143 row: `\| — \| Cap-counting functions lock first; no policy counts \| app/src/server/db/cap-locks.db.test.ts (C1-C4), app/src/server/errors/row-cap-lock.db.test.ts (R1-R3) \| EZD-321 \|`. | lesson EZD-152; L-041 (no test reads docs) |
| D8 Test isolation | `row-cap-lock.db.test.ts` holds `holdErrorAlertLock()` from `beforeAll` start to `afterAll` end; deletes all `error_alert` rows in `beforeAll`, `beforeEach`, `afterAll`. | `app/test-harness/errors/alert-lock.ts` (EZD-024 V7) |

### Do not touch
Existing migrations (EZD-298); `database.types.ts`; `audit.ts`; `private-execute.ts`.

Ticket row (phase-01.md): **Scope** `record_error_alert` counts the cap of 100 new error rows per hour per source group without a lock (`20261027001745_guard_gated_rpcs.sql` lines 193-204, `20261025043420_error_alert_caps_per_source.sql` lines 41-52, first in `20261023120001`), while the email cap at line 220 takes a lock before counting. Close the class: every function in `supabase/migrations` that counts rows to enforce a cap takes a lock first (search all migrations), in a new forward-only migration. **Done when** Parallel first-time errors from one source group never write more than 100 new error rows in an hour (test with parallel calls). A test fails when a function that enforces a row cap counts without taking a lock first. **Depends on** EZD-143. **Spec ref** Security review phase 1 gate 2026-11-03 (slice B finding); EZD-143; rules 17, 18.

## 2. Sources
- Ticket row; AC-EZD-321-1, -2; spec 11 Security and audit (no cap values; they come from EZD-143 section 3 and the bodies); CLAUDE.md rules 17, 18. No decisions; no research report.
- Probes on PostgreSQL 17.11, rolled back (L-009): D1, D6, all C2-C4 SQL; a session blocked on `pg_advisory_xact_lock` shows `Lock`/`advisory` in `pg_stat_activity`.

Architecture: Migrations; Errors and logging; Machine checks

## 3. Interface contract
| Kind | Name or path | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SQL function (body) | `public.record_error_alert(...)` | EZD-143 section 3 + D1 |
| type | `CapLockCode` | `'count_without_lock' \| 'unreadable_body' \| 'listed_counter_volatile' \| 'stale_read_only_counter' \| 'policy_counts'` |
| type | `CapLockProblem` | `{ fn: string; code: CapLockCode }`; a policy's `fn` is its `policy` key |
| type | `FunctionBody` | `{ fn: string; name: string; volatility: 'i' \| 's' \| 'v'; body: string }` |
| type | `PolicyText` | `{ policy: string; qual: string; withCheck: string }` |
| type, const | `ReadOnlyCounter`, `CAP_LOCK_READ_ONLY` | `{ fn: string; reason: string }`; `readonly ReadOnlyCounter[]` (D5) |
| export | `capLockProblems` | `(functions: readonly FunctionBody[], policies: readonly PolicyText[], readOnly?: readonly ReadOnlyCounter[]) => CapLockProblem[]`; pure; default `CAP_LOCK_READ_ONLY`; D3, D4 |
| export | `auditCapLocks` | `(sql: Sql \| TransactionSql, options?: { readOnly?: readonly ReadOnlyCounter[] }) => Promise<CapLockProblem[]>`; D6 then `capLockProblems`; types from `app/test-harness/rls/db.ts` |
| file | `app/test-harness/rls/cap-locks.ts` | all exports above |

# EZD-322 · Fix: a project member without See company costs cannot create a supplier file or order report record

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-322-1, AC-EZD-322-2, AC-EZD-322-3
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** security, permissions, storage, testing
- **User-visible result:** a member who may not see company costs can no longer leave a supplier file or order report entry (supplier name and email) on a project; members with the switch, and every other file type, work as before.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build

Data: none. No migration or policy change; table policies stay scope-only (Q-0323 (1)). Only server routes reach `source_file` (API gate, ARCH-SD, Q-0087), so the one helper that writes it holds the check.

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `app/src/server/storage/objects.ts` | change | `StorageErrorCode` gains `'permission_denied'` (add after `'upload_size_mismatch'`); nothing else | the existing union | `pnpm run typecheck` |
| 2 | `app/src/server/storage/source-files.ts` | change | new `export const COST_FILE_KINDS: readonly SourceFileKind[] = ['supplier_pdf', 'order_report']`; `startSourceFileUpload` signature unchanged; new private step D1 below | `requireApiPermission` order in `app/src/server/permissions/can.ts` (context, then key) | U1, D1 |
| 3 | `app/src/server/storage/index.ts` | change | add `COST_FILE_KINDS` to the `./source-files` export list | the existing list | `pnpm run typecheck` |
| 4 | `app/src/app/api/dev/storage/route.ts` | change | `POST` unchanged in shape; in the catch, before the `INPUT_CODES` branch: `StorageError` with code `permission_denied` → 403 (D3) | `permissionDenied` in `app/src/server/permissions/can.ts` | R1 |
| 5 | `docs/architecture.md` `## Storage buckets and paths`, bullet **Cost files** | change | append the sentence in D6 | none | `pnpm run lint` |

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Where and when the check runs | In `startSourceFileUpload`, right after `startSchema.safeParse` succeeds and before the `project` lookup: when `v.kind` is in `COST_FILE_KINDS`, or `v.supplierName` is not null/undefined, or `v.supplierContactEmail` is not null/undefined, the start is a cost record and the check runs; otherwise no extra call is made. Invalid input still answers `invalid_input` first. | ticket row (close the class in the helper); 03c source_file "supplier_name and supplier_contact_email (supplier files)"; finding 1 names the supplier name and email as what leaks; CLAUDE.md rule 18 |
| D2 How the check reads the switch | `loadPermissionContext(client, v.uploadedBy)` from `../permissions` on the caller's own client, then `can(ctx, 'see_company_costs')` with no target (key only, like Storage policy `K`). `null` ctx or `false` → `throw new StorageError('permission_denied')`. `loadPermissionContext` (`app/src/server/permissions/context.ts` lines 20-40) returns `null` for an rpc error with code `42501` or no row, and throws the rpc error object for any other error code; wrap the call in `try/catch` and turn any throw into `throw new StorageError('storage_unavailable')`. No row insert, no signing happens after a refusal. | ARCH-PE (`loadPermissionContext`, `can`); ARCH-S Cost files (`see_company_costs`, read live, key only); rule 18: the check reads the same token the insert uses, so no caller can pass a wrong context |
| D3 Route 403 | Body `{ error: { code: 'permission_denied', message_key: 'error.not_authorized' } }`, status 403, `Cache-Control: no-store`; not reported to Sentry. Write it as a local `permissionDenied()` const in `route.ts` with the same shape as `can.ts`'s. | ARCH-PE `requirePermission` 403 body; ARCH-EL status 403 = permission missing |
| D4 Extra query | One `current_permissions` RPC more per cost-record start (the route's own context is loaded by `requireApiPermission`); other starts make none. Accepted: rule 18 prefers the check that cannot drift. | rule 18; ARCH-PE one query per request (this is the documented exception, D6) |
| D5 Complete route | `POST /api/dev/storage/<id>/complete` and `completeSourceFileUpload` unchanged: a refused start leaves no row to complete. | ticket row |
| D6 Docs sentence | "`startSourceFileUpload` refuses a `supplier_pdf` or `order_report` start, or any start with a supplier name or contact email, from a member without `see_company_costs` with `permission_denied` before any row is written (routes answer 403 `error.not_authorized`); it reads the switch with `loadPermissionContext` on the caller's client, one extra `current_permissions` call for these starts only, so every route that reuses it inherits the check (EZD-322)." | ARCH-S; CLAUDE.md rule 7 practice of keeping the conventions file true |
| D7 Error class | Reuse `StorageError`; no new class. | `objects.ts` |
| D8 Header comments | `source-files.ts` line 1-5 comment gains "a cost record (EZD-322 D1) is refused without See company costs before any write"; `route.ts` order comment (lines 3-5) becomes "... then 403 or 404 (permission), then the helper's 403 (`permission_denied`) and 400s, then 500". | lesson EZD-152 (comments restate the new rule) |

### Do not touch
`supabase/migrations/**` (no new migration; released files never edited); Storage policies `K`, `K2`; `completeSourceFileUpload`; `app/src/app/api/dev/storage/[id]/complete/route.ts`; `app/src/server/permissions/**`; every test file (test-author's, rule 5).

Ticket row: **Scope** Security review at the phase 1 gate (2026-11-04), finding 1: `app/src/server/storage/source-files.ts` has no `see_company_costs` check and `app/src/app/api/dev/storage/route.ts:62` checks Edit model only, so a member without See company costs can create a supplier file or order report record (supplier name and email) that everyone on the project sees; only the upload itself is refused (Q-0323). Close the class in the shared helper, so the real upload routes that reuse it inherit the check, not in the one dev route. **Done when** A member without See company costs gets 403 when creating a supplier file or an order report record, through the helper and through the dev route, and no row is written; a member with it succeeds; other file types are unchanged (tests, two members). **Depends on** EZD-132. **Spec ref** Security review phase 1 gate 2026-11-04 (finding 1); Q-0323; rules 17, 18.

## 2. Sources
- Ticket row, `vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md` (EZD-322); AC-EZD-322-1..3, `vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md`.

- Q-0323 (1) (`QUESTIONS-answered.md`): AC-EZD-102-6 amended; table policies stay scope-only. Q-0269 (b) (`QUESTIONS-archive.md`): supplier_pdf and order_report are cost files, gated by See company costs.
- Merged code: `source-files.ts` (row inserted at line 117 before signing at 141: the hole); `supabase/migrations/20261026120000_create_source_file.sql` lines 18-19 (supplier fields allowed on any kind).
- `docs/architecture.md`: ARCH-S = `## Storage buckets and paths` (Cost files bullet); ARCH-PE = `### Permission enforcement (EZD-102)`; ARCH-SD = `## Server-only data access and can()` (API request gate); ARCH-EL = `## Errors and logging`.

Input base: `{ projectId: P, kind, originalName: 'quote.pdf', contentType: 'application/pdf', size: 100, uploadedBy }`, `uploadedBy` = the acting member's `appUserId` (U1: any `randomUUID()`). "Cost rows of F" = `select count(*)::int from public.source_file where uploaded_by = F.appUserId and (kind in ('supplier_pdf','order_report') or supplier_name is not null or supplier_contact_email is not null)` via `harnessSql()`. Every file's top-level `describe` starts `EZD-322`.

# EZD-323 · Fix: no test-only database function can be run by a signed-in user in production

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-323-1, AC-EZD-323-2, AC-EZD-323-3
- **Complexity:** high
- **Areas:** migrations, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** none on screen; signed-in users can no longer run the test sender, and the build fails if a later test-only database function is open to them.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build

Data: migration M1 only; the EZD-110a migration is not edited (ARCH-RS M2). The drop is allowed: origin has no `phase-*` tag (2026-11-04; ARCH-RS "No tag yet").

**M1** `supabase/migrations/<ts>_send_test_notification_server_only.sql` (`pnpm supabase migration new`; probed L-009):
1. Header comment naming EZD-323 M1. 2. `drop function public.send_test_notification(text, uuid, jsonb);`
3. `create function public.send_test_notification(p_membership_id uuid, p_kind text, p_project_id uuid, p_payload jsonb) returns uuid language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path = ''`; body (`v_tenant`, `v_user`, `v_id` uuid): `perform private.require_api_gate();` → `select m.tenant_id, m.user_id into v_tenant, v_user from public.membership m where m.id = p_membership_id and m.status = 'active';` → if either is null `raise exception 'not_authorized' using errcode = '42501';` → `v_id := private.create_notification(v_tenant, v_user, p_kind, p_project_id, coalesce(p_payload, '{}'::jsonb), '/');` → null raises the same → `return v_id;`.
4. `revoke all on function public.send_test_notification(uuid, text, uuid, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;` then `grant execute on function public.send_test_notification(uuid, text, uuid, jsonb) to service_role;` (L-016).

### Build steps

# EZD-324 · Fix: the device layout test B5 does not fail at random in CI

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-324-1, AC-EZD-324-2 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md` lines 615–616)
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** testing, ui, ci
- **User-visible result:** none in the app; the iPad layout-switch browser test stops failing at random in CI, so merges are not held up by it.
- Phase: 2 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Cause, found and measured in this planning session (section 2, E1–E6): **a wrong wait in the test, not a late switch in the app.** WebKit reports a media-query change only in its next rendering update (the HTML "update the rendering" steps: media-query changes are reported before animation-frame callbacks run). On a CPU-starved headless Linux WebKit, that update came 4 to 23 s after `setViewportSize` returned. B5 starts its 5 s expect window at `setViewportSize`, so it timed out before the browser had told the app anything. Once the change event fires, the app switches within 1.3 s (E5). The ticket row's rule therefore applies: the fix goes in the test. No assertion is removed or weakened. The fix adds a wait for the browser's next animation frame after each resize.

No data, no migration, no app code.

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `app/e2e/device-layouts.spec.ts` (test-author) | change | none exported. Add module-level `const nextFrame = (page: Page): Promise<void> => page.evaluate(() => new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve())));`, placed directly after `coarse` (lines 53–54). Put this comment line above it: `// EZD-324: WebKit reports a media-query change in its next rendering update, before animation-frame callbacks; wait for it.` In B5 (line 246): rename the title to `'EZD-014c B5 layout switches live at 1024 px (EZD-324)'`, and add `await nextFrame(page);` on the line right after `await page.setViewportSize({ width, height });` (line 260). Nothing else changes | the module-level helpers `coarse` and `probe` in the same file (a `page.evaluate` arrow); the B6 `toPass` wait in the same file shows a wait in front of an unchanged assertion | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/app exec playwright test e2e/device-layouts.spec.ts --project=ipad-landscape -g "EZD-324" --repeat-each=20 --workers=4` prints `20 passed`, no `failed`, no `flaky` |
| 2 | none (builder) | none | none. The builder changes no file. In the worktree it runs `pnpm db:up` (the config throws `Local Supabase is not running: run pnpm db:up` without it), then `pnpm build`, then the step 1 command, and reports the output. Any failed or flaky repeat is a `PLAN-GAP` to the planner with the failure output; the builder changes nothing to make it pass | none | step 1 command after `pnpm db:up` and `pnpm build` (the config's `webServer` runs `pnpm start`, which serves `.next`) |

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| App or test fix | Test. App code, CSS and `useDeviceLayout` stay as they are | section 2 E3–E5; ticket row ("a wrong wait in the test is fixed in the test") |
| Wait used | One `requestAnimationFrame` callback in the page, awaited through `page.evaluate`. Not two frames, not a fixed sleep, not a longer expect timeout, not `toPass`, not a wait for hydration, not a poll of `matchMedia(...).matches`. One frame is enough because a frame callback runs only inside a rendering update, and that update evaluates media queries and fires `change` before it runs frame callbacks; the request is made after `setViewportSize` resolves with `innerWidth` already at the new size (E3). A `matches` poll does not wait for the event, since `matches` was true while the event was still pending (E3, E4) | HTML "update the rendering" order (media-query changes reported, then animation-frame callbacks); E5 (0 of 45 failed with this wait); a longer timeout would only widen the window and could still lose to a 23 s frame (E4) |
| Expect timeouts | Unchanged: the config default of 5 s on every B5 expect | ticket row ("no assertion is removed or weakened"); `app/playwright.config.ts` (no `expect.timeout`) |
| Timeout on the frame wait | None of its own. The test timeout of 60000 ms bounds it, and a missing frame fails the test | `app/playwright.config.ts` `timeout: 60000` |
| Helper location | Local to `device-layouts.spec.ts`, not exported, not in `test-harness/`. B5 is the only WebKit test that resizes a loaded page and waits on a JS-driven switch | `grep setViewportSize app/e2e` (3 hits: B4 desktop Chromium, CSS-only; `disclaimer.spec.ts:181` resizes before `goto`; B5); CLAUDE.md rule 4 |
| Wait on every step or only phone steps | Every step, all five, in the existing loop | the loop sets the size for every step; the `full` steps read the same JS state (`DeviceLayout.tsx`) |
| Title | `EZD-014c B5 layout switches live at 1024 px (EZD-324)`. The ticket id puts B5 into the phase-2 ticket gate's scope | `scripts/gate.mjs` `scopeFor()` grep `EZD-(?:<phase ids>)(?![0-9a-z])\|@smoke`; architecture `## Tests` ("the test that closes a ticket has the ticket id in its title") |
| Tag | Unchanged: `{ tag: ['@ipad'] }` | EZD-014c plan section 4 B5 |
| Steps, URLs, marker, assertions | Unchanged: the five `[width, height, want]` rows, `page.url()` equal, `__ezdMarker` 1 | EZD-014c plan section 4 B5; Q-0054 (a) |
| Formatting | `pnpm exec prettier --write app/e2e/device-layouts.spec.ts` | architecture `## Tests` |

The architecture `### Device layouts (EZD-014)` says "one `change` listener and no resize listener".
- Every other test in `device-layouts.spec.ts` (B1–B4, B6–B8, EZD-158), and its imports.
- `app/playwright.config.ts` (`workers: 4` Q-0114, `retries: 0`, `timeout: 60000`); `app/test-harness/**`.

Ticket row (`vault/tickets/phases/phase-02.md` line 49):
- Scope: Rule 17 defect: `app/e2e/device-layouts.spec.ts` EZD-014c B5 failed the gate on develop at 232e1372 (CI run 41792230950, ipad-landscape): at width 1023 the phone frame was not visible within 5 seconds; 190 other browser tests passed. Find the cause first: a real late or missed layout switch is fixed in the app; a wrong wait in the test is fixed in the test. No assertion is removed or weakened.
- Done when: B5 passes 20 runs in a row with the full suite's worker count (test). The layout still switches at 1023 and 1024 px without a reload (test).

## 2. Sources

- Q-0054 (a) (`vault/questions/QUESTIONS-archive.md` line 25): full editor from 1024 px wide, the phone layout below 1024 px. This is the source of the 1024/1023 steps.
- `vault/plans/EZD-014c.md` section 4 row B5 (steps, expected values); section 3 (selectors `data-shell-region`, `data-phone-region`, spec imports).
- Code read on develop 4b6d4411: `app/src/lib/device/device-layout.ts` (`PHONE_LAYOUT_QUERY` `(width < 1024px)`, `subscribeDeviceLayout` = one `change` listener); `useDeviceLayout.ts` (`useSyncExternalStore`, server snapshot `full`); `DeviceLayout.tsx`; `app/test-harness/e2e/devices.ts` (`ipad-landscape` = `iPad Pro 11 landscape`, `defaultBrowserType` `webkit`, 1180 × 820); `app/playwright.config.ts` (`workers: 4`, `retries: 0`, `timeout: 60000`, `webServer` `pnpm start`).
- Evidence (this session; probe scripts in `/tmp/ezd324-probe`, outside the repo; build of develop 4b6d4411; `/dev/device` in the iPad context):
  - E1 CI run 41792230950, artifact `gate-logs`: `Error: 1023 … locator('[data-phone-region="frame"]') Expected: visible Timeout: 5000ms Error: element(s) not found`; B5 took 6.4 s. Of the last 80 `ci.yml` runs, this is the only failure whose log names B5.
  - E2 It does not reproduce on an unloaded Mac or under host CPU load. B5 ran 40 of 40 times with 4 workers; with 16 `yes` processes it ran 40 of 40 with 12 workers. Mac WebKit, Playwright 1.64.1.
  - E3 It does reproduce in Linux WebKit (`mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble`, `--cpus=1`, 4 probe processes at once): 7 of 160 resize-to-1023 runs had no phone frame after 6 s. In those runs `innerWidth` was 1023, `matchMedia('(width < 1024px)').matches` was true, the shell frame was still mounted, and the phone frame appeared later with no further input.
  - E4 Instrumenting `matchMedia` shows the cause. In each failing run the app's `change` listener was attached before the resize (for example, attached at 4298 ms, resize at 4581 ms), but the `change` event was delivered at 31098 ms. The first `requestAnimationFrame` after a resize ran 4 to 23 s later, and the `change` event fired just before it (for example 27894 ms and 28072 ms; 9698 ms and 9708 ms).
  - E5 With one awaited animation frame after each resize: 0 of 45 failed, and the phone frame was seen at most 1300 ms after the frame returned. With a resize before hydration, the frame also appeared right after hydration (the store's commit-time check), so a hydration wait adds nothing.
  - E6 `grep -n setViewportSize app/e2e app/test-harness`: `device-layouts.spec.ts:236` (B4, desktop Chromium, CSS-only checks), `:260` (B5), `disclaimer.spec.ts:181` (before `goto`).
- No research report covers this ticket; no retriever was dispatched.
- Non-goals, glossary: no entry bears on this test fix.

# EZD-140 · Notification settings per user

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-140-1, AC-EZD-140-2, AC-EZD-140-3, AC-EZD-140-4
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** ui, data-model, migrations, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** in My profile → Notifications, Josh sees the nine notification kinds with an In app and an Email switch each, all on; he turns one kind's Email off, saves, and the next notification of that kind shows in the bell with no email.
- Phase: 2 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-10-29 (re-validated 2026-11-04 against EZD-108 f8904f94, EZD-110a dd1e24c3, EZD-110b 232e1372) · Status: planned

## 1. What to build

Data (03b rule 1; 11 rule 10; ARCH Row-level security):
- **M1** `supabase/migrations/<ts>_create_notification_setting.sql` (D14): table `public.notification_setting` (probed, section 2): `tenant_id uuid not null references public.tenant (id) on delete cascade`, `user_id uuid not null references public.app_user (id) on delete cascade`, `kind text not null check (kind in (<the nine NOTIFICATION_KINDS, EZD-110 D1 order>))`, `in_app boolean not null default true`, `email boolean not null default true`, `updated_at timestamptz not null default now()`, `primary key (tenant_id, user_id, kind)` (its first column serves as the tenant index); RLS on; policy `notification_setting_select` for select to authenticated using `tenant_id = (select private.tenant_id()) and user_id = (select private.app_user_id())`; restrictive `notification_setting_api_gate` (ARCH RLS template); no insert, update or delete policy; `grant select … to authenticated; grant select, insert, update, delete … to service_role;`.
- **M2** `…<ts>_create_save_my_notification_settings.sql` (D14): `public.save_my_notification_settings(p_settings jsonb) returns void`, plpgsql volatile security definer `set search_path = ''`, as probed: `perform private.require_api_gate()`; tenant or user null → `42501 not_authorized`; not an array of 9 → `22023 invalid_input`; every element an object with a listed string `kind` and boolean `in_app` and `email`, 9 distinct kinds, else `22023 invalid_input`; upsert on `(tenant_id, user_id, kind)` updating `in_app`, `email`, `updated_at = now()` only where `(in_app, email)` is distinct. `revoke all on function public.save_my_notification_settings(jsonb) from public, anon, service_role; grant execute … to authenticated;` (L-016).
- **M3** `…<ts>_apply_notification_settings.sql` (D14; redefines EZD-110a objects merged at dd1e24c3; confirm on pinned version, L-009). Merged sources: `T` = `supabase/migrations/20261102210537_create_notification.sql`, `F` = `supabase/migrations/20261102210539_create_notification_functions.sql`.
  1. `alter table public.notification add column in_app boolean not null default true;`
  2. `alter policy notification_select on public.notification using (tenant_id = (select private.tenant_id()) and user_id = (select private.app_user_id()) and (project_id is null or (select private.all_projects()) or project_id = any ((select private.listed_project_ids())::uuid[])) and in_app);` (the merged `using` of `T`, plus `and in_app`).
  3. `drop trigger notification_broadcast_created on public.notification;` then `create trigger notification_broadcast_created after insert on public.notification for each row when (new.in_app) execute function private.notification_broadcast_created();` (`T`'s trigger plus the `when`; `drop trigger` is outside Release safety's scan).
  4. `create or replace function private.create_notification(p_tenant_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_kind text, p_project_id uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_link text) returns uuid language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path = ''`: `F`'s body unchanged except: declare `v_in_app boolean; v_email boolean;`; after its last refusal (the listed-scope project check) and before the insert: `select s.in_app, s.email into v_in_app, v_email from public.notification_setting s where s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id and s.user_id = p_user_id and s.kind = p_kind;` then `v_in_app := coalesce(v_in_app, true); v_email := coalesce(v_email, true);`; the `public.notification` insert adds column `in_app` with value `v_in_app`; the `public.job` insert is wrapped in `if v_email then … end if;`. Returns `v_id` as before. Then `revoke all on function private.create_notification(uuid, uuid, text, uuid, jsonb, text) from public;` (`F`).
  5. `create or replace` of `public.open_notification(uuid)` and `public.mark_all_notifications_read()`: `F`'s bodies (`#variable_conflict use_column` and `returns table (link text, project_id uuid, project_state text)` kept) plus `and n.in_app` in open's `select … from public.notification n where … for update` and in mark-all's `update public.notification n … where`; nothing else; then `F`'s revoke and grant lines for each, repeated (`revoke all … from public, anon, service_role; grant execute … to authenticated;`). `public.list_notifications` is not redefined: `F` makes it `security invoker`, so step 2's policy hides `in_app = false` rows from its items, `hasMore` and `unreadCount`.
