# EZD-326 · Fix: test: EZD-025 T3 versioning and Object Lock must be on, before any write: (a) one failed files run row

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-326-1, AC-EZD-326-2
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** testing, scripts, backup
- **User-visible result:** the backup tests no longer fail at random in CI, because one test file's cleanup can no longer delete the rows or users another test file is still using.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Test-only ticket. Both files are under `scripts/backup/__tests__/`, which `.claude/hooks/guard-paths.mjs` line 29 marks as test files, so the **test-author writes both** and the builder may not (guard-paths.mjs line 92; L-002). No builder round: test-author commit, then gate and reviews (Q-0464 (a), the same case on EZD-281). No app, `scripts/` (non-test) or `vault/` file changes. Data: none (no migration; table `public.backup_run` from `supabase/migrations/20261023140000_create_backup_run.sql` is only read and written by tests).

**Cause (AC-EZD-326-2), with evidence E1-E6 (develop 54a13513):**
| # | Evidence | What it shows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | gate-logs artifact of CI run 41818712171, `gate.log` lines 476-506 | T3 (a) at `files.test.mjs:155` read `[]`; T2 and T4 of the same suite passed; 1 failure in the run |
| E2 | `local-fixture.mjs:236` `delete from public.backup_run where scope like 'buckets:ezd025-%'` | `cleanup()` deletes every test file's `buckets:ezd025-…` rows, not only its own; T3 (a)'s scope is `buckets:ezd025-<suffix>-a` (`files.test.mjs:141`, bucket name from `local-fixture.mjs:203`), which the pattern matches |
| E3 | `cleanup()` runs in the `after` of `files.test.mjs:59`, `restore-drill.test.mjs:70` and `:272`, `soft-delete.test.mjs:64`; each file holds only the shared lock (`scripts/test-harness/db-lock.mjs:14`); `package.json:11` runs the root files with `--test-concurrency=4` | another file's `cleanup()` can run between T3's insert (`files.mjs:43`) and its read (`files.test.mjs:151`) |
| E4 | planner run on the local stack, 2026-11-04: `node --import ./app/test-harness/net-guard/preload.mjs --test scripts/backup/__tests__/files.test.mjs` alone: 6 of 6 ok; the same while a loop runs the E2 statement every 50 ms: T2, T3 and T4 (a) fail, T3 with `(a) one failed files run row` and actual `[]` | the E2 delete reproduces the CI message exactly |
| E5 | `local-fixture.mjs:213` inserts the app user, `:215` its membership; `:241` deletes every `ezd025-%@example.com` app user that has no membership | same class: another file's `cleanup()` between `:213` and `:215` deletes this file's new app user and the membership insert fails |
| E6 | causes the ticket row names and that are ruled out: the row goes to the main stack (`realDeps` and `query` both use `stackStatus()` / `supabase_db_ezdraft`; E4 baseline passes); the truncating file takes the exclusive lock (`db-lock.mjs:31`) and `files.test.mjs:42` holds the shared lock for the whole suite, so no truncate can run during T3; no other test deletes `files` rows by these scopes (`check.test.mjs:422` deletes `ezd1704-` scopes only, `db.test.mjs:38` `db_dump` rows with a location, `restore.test.mjs:386` `restore_drill` rows) | the cause is E2 (and E5 for the users) |

Fix: `cleanup()` deletes only what its own process recorded in `made` (each `node --test` file runs in its own process, so its own process means its own file).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `scripts/backup/__tests__/cleanup-scope.test.mjs` (test-author) | new | none; top-level `describe('EZD-326 cleanup() removes only what this process made', { skip: !inScope('EZD-326') })` with tests T1, T2 of section 4 | `scripts/backup/__tests__/soft-delete.test.mjs` lines 22-27 and 47-67 (shared lock in the first `before`, released last in `after`) | `node --import ./app/test-harness/net-guard/preload.mjs --test scripts/backup/__tests__/cleanup-scope.test.mjs` fails T1 and T2 on the unchanged fixture (record the two failure lines in the commit message) |
| 2 | `scripts/backup/__tests__/local-fixture.mjs` (test-author) | change: `made` at line 135, `createDrillData` line 213, `cleanup()` lines 227-245 | `cleanup(): Promise<void>` unchanged; `made` becomes `{ buckets: [], tenants: [], authUsers: [], appUsers: [] }`; `createDrillData` adds `made.appUsers.push(appUserId)` right after line 213 | its own lines 230-244 (per-id deletes) | step 1 command: T1 and T2 pass; then `node --import ./app/test-harness/net-guard/preload.mjs --test scripts/backup/__tests__/files.test.mjs scripts/backup/__tests__/soft-delete.test.mjs scripts/backup/__tests__/restore-drill.test.mjs`: all ok |

## 1. What to build

No money field. SQL probed on pinned PostgreSQL 17.11 (L-009). NN = `not null`. "Tenant fk" = columns `project_id`, `tenant_id` uuid NN; `tenant_id` → tenant on delete cascade; `(project_id, tenant_id)` → `project (id, tenant_id)` on delete cascade; index `tenant_id`.
- **M1 `edit_lock`** (03e; 00d): `project_id uuid` pk; tenant fk; `lock_epoch bigint NN default 0 check (>= 0)`. EZD-125 adds the holder columns.
- **M2 `model_object`** (03d; 03e): pk `(project_id, object_id uuid)`; tenant fk; `type text NN check (type ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$')`; `data jsonb NN` (object); `schema_version integer NN (>= 1)`; `updated_seq integer NN (>= 1)` (Decided "Seq type"); `updated_by uuid` → app_user on delete set null; `deleted boolean NN default false`; `created_at`, `updated_at timestamptz NN default now()`.
- **M3 `model_version`** (03c; 03b rule 7; Q-0507 gap 16): `id uuid` pk default `gen_random_uuid()`; tenant fk; `model_json jsonb NN` (object); `schema_version integer NN (>= 1)`; `parent_version_id uuid` → model_version on delete set null; `label`, `sent_to`, `preview_path text`; `is_snapshot`, `is_sent`, `keep boolean NN default false`; `sent_at`, `cleanup_shown_at timestamptz`; `version_no integer`; `created_by uuid` (no fk); `created_at timestamptz NN default clock_timestamp()`; index `(project_id, created_at desc, id desc)`. Trigger (before update, row; invoker) `private.model_version_immutable`: 55000, same name, when `id`, `tenant_id`, `project_id`, `model_json`, `schema_version`, `created_by` or `created_at` changes, or `parent_version_id` changes to non-null.
- **Access M1–M3**: RLS; `<table>_select` to authenticated, template of 20261019170006 lines 7–9; restrictive `<table>_api_gate` and grants as 20261102210537; no write policy.
- **M4** (Q-0508; Q-0530): after-insert row trigger `project_first_floor` on project (`private.project_first_floor()`, definer) inserts one model_object: `object_id gen_random_uuid()`, `type 'floor'`, `data {"name":"Floor 1","order":1}`, `schema_version 1`, `updated_seq 1`, `updated_by null`; the migration adds it to each existing project lacking one.
- **M5 `public.save_objects(p_project uuid, p_lock_epoch bigint, p_changes jsonb) returns jsonb`** (03b rules 6, 9; plpgsql, volatile, definer, `search_path ''`; first failing step decides): (1) `perform private.require_api_gate()`; (2) `private.tenant_id()`, `private.app_user_id()` or claim `membership_id` null → 42501 `permission_denied`; (3) no granted `edit_model` row in `user_permission` → 42501 (as 20261026130000 lines 39–48); (4) null or `not private.can_see_project(p_project)` → P0002 `project_not_found`; (5) 22023 `invalid_input` when `p_lock_epoch` is null or < 0, or `p_changes` breaks a rule of Decided "parseSaveRequest" (snake keys `id`, `base_seq`, `deleted`, `type`, `schema_version`, `data`; exact key sets; `id` checked by `~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'`; `base_seq` a whole JSON number from its minimum to 2147483647, then cast `::integer`; loop as 20261104094232); (6) `select lock_epoch … for update`; no row: `p_lock_epoch <> 0` → stale, else insert on conflict do nothing and select again; (7) stored ≠ `p_lock_epoch` → `{"status":"stale_lock_epoch"}`; (8) changes whose `base_seq` ≠ `coalesce(stored updated_seq, 0)` → `{"status":"conflict","conflicts":[{"object_id","server_seq"}]}` (by object_id; 0 when no row); (9) no count cap; insert `base_seq` 0 changes at seq 1; update the rest (`type`, `data`, `schema_version` when sent, `deleted`, `updated_seq + 1`, `updated_at now()`); `updated_by` = user; (10) `{"status":"saved","tenant_id","objects":[{"object_id","updated_seq"}]}` by object_id. (7) and (8) write no model_object row.
- **M6** (03b rule 7; Q-0507 gap 16): `private.make_checkpoint(p_project uuid, p_actor uuid) returns uuid` (invoker): no project → P0002; edit_lock row ensured and locked as M5 (6); parent = newest version by `(created_at desc, id desc)`; inserts one version: `model_json {"objects":[{"id","type","schema_version","data"}]}` from non-deleted rows by object_id (`[]` when none), `schema_version` their min (1 when none), `created_by p_actor`, other columns at their defaults (null, false); returns its id. `public.create_checkpoint(p_project uuid) returns uuid` (definer): M5 (1)–(4), then `private.make_checkpoint(p_project, v_user)`.
- **Grants**: each function `revoke all … from public` (L-016); public ones also from anon, service_role, then execute to authenticated.

# EZD-120b · Patch store, outbox and autosave

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-120b-1 to AC-EZD-120b-5
- **Complexity:** high
- **Areas:** data-model, security, testing, dependencies
- **User-visible result:** none yet; the editor's edit, undo and autosave engine.
- Phase: 3 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned · Re-validated 2026-11-05 against f8bd91f1, a0c9e51a · Plan gap 2026-11-05: storage failure (Q-0596)

## 1. What to build

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |

| Patch | store sets `before` (null: add); `after` null: remove; an id twice → `throw new Error('duplicate_object_id')`, no change; empty edit → `[]`, no `onCommit`, not recorded | 11 rule 1; 03b rule 4 |
| Undo, redo | `applyEdit` pushes the `Edit` on `past`, clears `future`; `undo` applies the same `Edit` back onto `future`; `redo` the reverse; empty → `[]`; no depth limit (no source) | AC-2 |
| Changed ids | a commit returns its ids in patch order, sets `lastChangedIds`, calls `onCommit` once with those `Change`s; new `Map`, other values keep identity | AC-3; 11 rule 2 |
| Device database | `ezdraft-device` v1, stores `outbox`, `working_copy`, keys `[appUserId, tenantId, projectId, objectId]`; a storage uses only `IDBKeyRange.bound([u, t], [u, t, []])`; one lazy connection, closed by `close()` or `blocking`; `idb` only here (pinned; no guard test) | Q-0503; 03a |
| `put` | one transaction, both stores; new entry: `baseSeq` = `working_copy` `updatedSeq` or 0, `rev` 1, `queuedAt` now; existing: new `value`, `rev + 1`, rest kept | 03b rules 6, 9 |
| Batch | `list` sorted by `queuedAt`, projectId, id; first entry's project and `lockEpoch`, ≤ 100 (`MAX_CHANGES_PER_SAVE`, build choice); null value with `baseSeq` 0 → `drop`, not sent | P120a parseSaveRequest |
| Request | `{ lockEpoch, changes }`; a value → exactly `{ id, baseSeq, deleted: false, type, schemaVersion, data }`, null → exactly `{ id, baseSeq, deleted: true }` (strict: any other key is 400 `invalid_input`) | `S/server/model/model.ts` `parseSaveRequest` |
| Saved match | `commit` matches `saved` to `sent` by id (the response is in `object_id` order, not request order) | `supabase/migrations/20261105200004_create_model_save_functions.sql` step (10) |
| `commit`, `drop` | one transaction; `rev` unchanged → delete entry, else `baseSeq` = `updatedSeq`; `working_copy` = sent value + `updatedSeq` (a delete removes it); `drop` = delete if `rev` unchanged | 03b rule 9 |
| `classifySave` | 200 `saved`; 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 `refused` (`error.code`); else or throw `failed` | P120a; P202 |
| Refused | entries kept; `error`, `problem` = code; no drain until `retry()`; `retry()` sets `problem` null and drains now, as `flush()` (U7: 1 fetch at 0 ms after it) | Q-0502 (to EZD-299); orchestrator answer 2026-11-05 (answered-agent) |
| Failed | entries kept; retry after `RETRY_DELAYS_MS` [2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 30000] (last repeats); `error` from the 3rd failure in a row, else `pending`; 200 resets | Q-0507 gaps 4, 5 |
| Drain | `enqueue` restarts one `debounceMs` (2000) timer that drains: `lock.tryRun('ezdraft-outbox:<appUserId>:<tenantId>')`, one fetch at a time until empty, refused, failed or the timer pending; lock busy → retry in 2,000 ms; `flush()` drains now, resolves when done | 00d; ticket row |
| States | `idle` before any enqueue; `pending`; `saving` in a fetch; `saved` + `lastSavedAt` when a drain empties the outbox; `offline` while `online.getSnapshot()` is false (no drain; true → drain now) | S03 States; Q-0501; EZD-015a |
| `webTabLock` | `navigator.locks.request(name, { ifAvailable: true }, cb)`; `cb(null)` → `{ ran: false }`; no `navigator.locks` → run `fn` | build choice |
| Storage failure | Any storage throw: `captureBrowserError(e, 'outbox.storage')` via `import()`, status `error`, problem `storage_failed`; `enqueue` still resolves. A failed `put` adds `{ projectId, lockEpoch, changes, now }` to the end of an in-memory pending list; while the list is non-empty each later `enqueue` appends there and calls no `put`. A failed post-save `commit` adds `{ projectId, sent, saved }` to the front of the list. A failed `list` or `drop` keeps nothing (entries stay stored). While the list is non-empty: no fetch starts, no timer or `online` change drains, status stays `error` (outranks `offline`, never `saved`), a refused or failed outcome of a fetch already in flight leaves problem `storage_failed`. `retry()` first runs the list in order (`commit(projectId, sent, saved)`; `put(projectId, lockEpoch, changes, now)` with the original `now`), removing each on success; a throw stops it (rest kept, captured again, still `error`, no fetch); empty list → the Refused row's `retry()` (problem null, drain now) | Q-0596 (answered-agent 2026-11-05); ARCH Errors |
| Load route | P120a Route order with `view_projects`, then `loadModel(createSessionClient(), id, p.ctx)`, null → 404; catch → `reportRouteFailure(e, '/api/projects/[id]/model')`, 500; `no-store` | P120a |
| `loadModel` | session client (RLS); in parallel `project` (`id, name, tenant_id, customer:customer_id(name)`, `.maybeSingle()`), `edit_lock.lock_epoch` (none → 0), `model_object` (`deleted = false`, `.order('object_id').limit(1000)`), then `.gt('object_id', last)` pages until a short one; archived not filtered | 03b rule 1; `supabase/config.toml` `max_rows = 1000`; Q-0507 gap 16 |

| `canEdit` | `can(ctx, 'edit_model', { projectId })` | Q-0568 |
| Reopen | `loadWorkingCopy` = loaded objects + that project's entries on top; caller saves the load by `replaceMirror` | AC-4; 03a |

Required `thicknessSide`: thickness on the `left` or `right` seen on the plan walking start→end (09j 1: drawn east, `right` is south), or `center` (±thickness/2). Closing a chain changes only `thicknessSide`; a thickness change never moves `start`, `end` (EZD-203, EZD-205 own; unchecked) | Q-0575; Q-0559; Q-0569 (b); 09j; 09e |

(a) Live non-floor row: unless a live `floor` row of the project has `object_id` = `data->>'level'` (cast only when it matches M5's uuid regex; a missing or non-uuid `level` matches none), `raise exception using errcode = '23503', message = 'level_not_found', detail = <row object_id>::text`. (b) `tg_op = 'UPDATE'`, `old.type = 'floor'`, row now deleted or not a floor: lowest `object_id` of a live non-floor row naming it → same raise with that id. Deferred, so a floor added, restored or deleted with its objects in one save passes (Q-0509; Q-0511 (c)): `create constraint trigger model_object_level_check after insert or update on public.model_object deferrable initially deferred for each row execute function private.model_object_level_check()` | AC-5; Q-0530; Q-0540; CLAUDE.md rule 18 |
| Commit-time error | unconfirmed that PostgREST returns it; builder runs A4 first after step 11; a 200 is a PLAN-GAP | L-009 |
| Document checks | per object, first failing of: shape `{ id: z.uuid(), type: string, schema_version: number, data }` (else `invalid_data`, id = string `id` or `''`), `parseStoredObject`, `duplicate_id` (later one; case-insensitive), `level_not_found` (no floor of the document has it; lower-case). Issues in object order. Not `{ objects: array }` → `[{ id: '', issue: 'invalid_document' }]` | AC-1; AC-5 |
| `pointsEqual`; rounding | each coordinate by `coordsEqual`; the schema never rounds | 03g |

## 1. What to build
Model inches, y up; angles in degrees, counter-clockwise from +x [SP]. `d` = unit vector start→end, `L` = length, `n` = left normal `(−d.y, d.x)`, `t` = thickness, `P(s)` = start + d·s. Face offsets along n by `thicknessSide`: `right` → `oL = 0`, `oR = −t`; `left` → `oL = t`, `oR = 0`; `center` → `oL = t/2`, `oR = −t/2`.

Lines role `cut`; no end caps or corner joins (EZD-203) | 09h; S03 board 105; Q-0575 |

# EZD-279 · Fix: the read guard denies a Read, Grep or Glob of the secret files in any letter case

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-279-1, AC-EZD-279-2, AC-EZD-279-3
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** tooling, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** no agent can read or search the `.env` files, the launcher's config or the Claude sign-in file through Read, Grep or Glob, whatever letter case it types.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-10-30, re-validated 2026-11-04 on develop 88bbadd7 · Status: ready

## 1. What to build
Base: develop 88bbadd7 (EZD-260 a5d1e087 and EZD-277 41de137d merged; `pathKey`, `repoRoot` and `norm` in `.claude/hooks/lib.mjs` are as section 3 states). Steps name code text, not line numbers (EZD-155). Built in fix mode (Josh 2026-11-04, chat: "Yes, unfreeze those"): the interactive orchestrator does Build steps 1-3 while `vault/handoff/LAUNCHER_FIX.md` exists (guard-paths.mjs `fixMode`; PROCESS.md section 3 rule 19); "builder" in this plan means that orchestrator.

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `.claude/hooks/secret-paths.mjs` | new | `export function secretName(abs)` (S1-S3); `export function globReach(root, glob, ctx)` (P1-P7); `export function secretReason(tool, toolInput, cwd)` (H1-H4, texts W1-W3, W5); types exactly as section 3. Imports: node:fs `realpathSync`, node:os, node:path, and section 3 `imports`. Header comment C1. | `.claude/hooks/lib.mjs` (pure exported helpers, node built-ins only, comment above each rule) | `node --test scripts/hooks/secret-reads.test.mjs` |
| 2 | `.claude/hooks/guard-reads.mjs` | change | none (script). No static import of `./secret-paths.mjs`: X1 loads it with `await import()` inside its own `try`, so a missing or broken module gives W4 (the file is an ES module, top-level `await` is allowed). Insert block X1. Comment edit C2. | the existing `if (tool === 'Read' \|\| tool === 'Bash')` block in the same file | `node --test scripts/hooks/secret-reads.test.mjs scripts/hooks/guard-reads.test.mjs` |
| 3 | `.claude/settings.json` | change | none. In `hooks.PreToolUse`, the entry whose args end `/.claude/hooks/guard-reads.mjs`: `"matcher": "Read\|Bash"` becomes `"matcher": "Read\|Bash\|Grep\|Glob"`. Nothing else changes, entry order included. | the same entry | `node --test scripts/hooks/guard-reads.test.mjs scripts/hooks/spawn-limits.test.mjs` (EZD-000c T10 pins the other entries); the code-reviewer confirms a one-line diff |

**Helpers (module-private, in secret-paths.mjs).**
- `fold(p)` = `pathKey(norm(p), true)`.
- `realOr(p)` = `try { return norm(realpathSync.native(p)); } catch { return norm(p); }`.
- `targets(given, cwd, home)`: `g = norm(given)`. If `g === '~'`, `g = home`. If `g` starts with `~/`, `g = home + g.slice(1)`. `lexical = norm(path.resolve(norm(cwd), g))`. `raw = path.isAbsolute(g) ? g : norm(cwd) + '/' + g`; the raw join is not normalized, so the OS resolves `..` after links. `real` = `norm(realpathSync.native(raw))`, or `null` when that throws. Returns `[lexical]`, plus `real` when `real !== null && real !== lexical`.
- `under(dir, target)` (dir is target or an ancestor of it): `a = fold(dir).replace(/\/+$/, '')`, `t = fold(target)`. Return `a === '' || t === a || t.startsWith(a + '/')`.
- `lastSeg(p)` = `fold(p).split('/').filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? ''`.
- `pieces(s)`: walk the characters with `depth` (+1 on `{`, -1 on `}`, never below 0). Split at every whitespace character and at every `,` when `depth === 0`, and drop empty pieces. A `,` inside braces never splits.
- `kindText` = `{ env: 'a .env file', launcher: 'scripts/launcher.config.json', signin: 'the Claude sign-in file' }`.
- `mainRoot(rr)` (the main checkout; ticket worktrees sit under it at `<main>/.claude/worktrees/<T>`, EZD-250 D1a, `.gitignore` line 10): `rr === null` → `null`. Else `m = /^(.+)\/\.claude\/worktrees\/[^/]+$/i.exec(rr)`; return `m ? m[1] : rr`. `rr` is EZD-260 `repoRoot()`, so a worktree project dir and the main project dir give the same `main`.

**S `secretName(abs)`**: `segs = fold(abs).split('/').filter(Boolean)`, `b = segs.at(-1) ?? ''`, `p = segs.at(-2) ?? ''`. Check in this order:
- **S1** `b === '.env' \|\| (b.startsWith('.env.') && b !== '.env.example')` → `'env'`.
- **S2** `p === 'scripts' && b === 'launcher.config.json'` → `'launcher'`.
- **S3** `b === '.credentials.json' \|\| (p === '.claude' && b.startsWith('.cred'))` → `'signin'`.
- Otherwise `null`.

**P `globReach(root, glob, ctx)`** (pure: no file system access):
- **P1** `g = glob.trim()` (no `norm`: a `\` must reach P4). If `g === ''` or `g` starts with `!`, return `null`.
- **P2** `alts = braces(g)` (as typed, never folded: folding a class range shrinks it, `[F-n]` → `[f-n]` loses `e`). `braces` expands the first `{`…`}` group at depth 0: it splits the group's content at depth-0 commas (a group with no comma gives its content), builds prefix + each alternative + suffix, and expands each result again. An unmatched `{` or `}`, or more than 64 results, makes `globReach` return `'unreadable'`.
- **P3** For each `a` of `alts`, in order: if `ctx.tool === 'Grep'`, strip leading `/`s and set `base = root`. Otherwise `base = a.startsWith('/') ? '/' : root`. Then `segs = a.split('/')`, `F = segs.at(-1)`, `D = segs.slice(0, -1).filter((s) => s !== '')`. `lit` = the leading entries of `D` before the first entry that holds any of `* ? [ ] { } !`. `dir = norm(path.posix.resolve(base, ...lit))`. `deep = ctx.tool === 'Grep' \|\| D.some((s) => /[*?[\]{}!]/.test(s))`. If `F === ''` or `F === '**'`, set `F = '*'`.
- **P4** Return `'unreadable'` when any part of `a` (each entry of `D`, and `F`) contains `\`, or any of `@(`, `!(`, `+(`, `*(`, `?(`, or a `[` that has no closing `]` under P5. A folder part is checked too, because ripgrep reads `sc\ripts` as `scripts`.
- **P5** `T = compile(F)`, from `F` as typed. Tokens: a run of `*` → `{ star: true }`; `?` → `{ src: '[^/]' }`; `[` opens a class → `{ src: <class> }`; any other character → `{ src: <escaped>, lit: true }` (`/[.*+?^${}()\|[\]\\]/g` → `\\$&`). Class: a leading `!` or `^` becomes `^`, and a `]` directly after `[`, `[!` or `[^` is a literal; the class ends at the next `]`; inside it `-` between two characters stays a range, `\`, `[`, `]` and `^` are escaped with `\`, every other character is copied as is. Every non-star token keeps two RegExps: `cs = new RegExp('^(?:' + src + ')$', 'u')` (case-sensitive, as ripgrep) and `ci = new RegExp('^(?:' + src + ')$', 'iu')` (Unicode simple case folding: `ſ` matches `s`, as `pathKey` folds). `accept(tok, c)` = `tok.cs.test(c) \|\| tok.cs.test(c.toLowerCase()) \|\| tok.cs.test(c.toUpperCase()) \|\| tok.ci.test(c)`: a token accepts `c` when it accepts any case of it, so a range keeps its typed bounds and a negated class `[!E]` still accepts `e` (security round 2). When any `new RegExp` throws (a reversed range such as `[z-a]`), `compile` returns `null` and `globReach` returns `'unreadable'`. `walk(T, s)`: an exact NFA over the tokens: `S = close({0})`, then for each character `c` of `s`, `S = close({ i : i in S, T[i] is a star, c !== '/' } ∪ { i + 1 : i in S, i < T.length, T[i] not a star, accept(T[i], c) })`; returns `S`. `match(F, name)` = `walk(T, name)` contains `T.length`. No whole-name RegExp is built, so `match` and `prefixHit` agree.
- **P5a** `prefixHit(T, pre, except)`: true when the matcher accepts some name that starts with `pre` (in any case) and, when `except` is given, is not `except` in any case. Exact, by stepping a set `S` of token positions:
  1. `S` = `close({0})`; `close` adds `i + 1` for each `i` in `S` whose token is a star, repeatedly.
  2. For each character `c` of `pre`: `S` = `close({ i : i in S, T[i] is a star } ∪ { i + 1 : i in S, i < T.length, T[i] not a star, accept(T[i], c) })` (the `walk` step). An empty `S` returns false.
  3. Some `i` in `S` with a star in `T.slice(i)` → true (the rest takes names of every length).
  4. For each `i` in `S`, `R = T.slice(i)`: true when `except` is undefined, or `R.length !== except.length - pre.length`, or some `R[j]` is not `lit`, or `!accept(R[j], except[pre.length + j])`.
  5. Otherwise false. A class or `?` in step 4 counts as able to match another name (fail closed; it can only refuse more, such as `.env.[e]xample`).
- **P6** `at(target)` = `deep ? under(dir, target) : fold(dir) === fold(target)`. Folder and dir compares stay folded.
  - `'env'` when `match(F, '.env') \|\| prefixHit(T, '.env.', '.env.example')`. This applies in any folder.
  - `'launcher'` when `match(F, 'launcher.config.json') && ((ctx.repoRoot !== null && at(ctx.repoRoot + '/scripts')) \|\| lastSeg(dir) === 'scripts')`.
  - `'signin'` when `(match(F, '.credentials.json') \|\| prefixHit(T, '.cred')) && (at(ctx.home + '/.claude') \|\| lastSeg(dir) === '.claude')`.
  - Check the kinds in that order. The first alternative that gives a kind or `'unreadable'` returns it.
- **P7** No alternative gives a kind → `null`.

**H `secretReason(tool, ti, cwd)`**: `home = realOr(os.homedir())`, `rr = repoRoot()`, `str(v) = typeof v === 'string' && v !== '' ? v : null`. A field that is not a string is treated as absent.
- **H1 Read**: `f = str(ti.file_path)`. If `f` is `null`, return `null`. For each `t` of `targets(f, cwd, home)`: when `k = secretName(t)` is not null, return W1(`f`, `k`).
- **H2 Grep**: `p = str(ti.path)`. `bases = p ? targets(p, cwd, home) : [...new Set([norm(cwd), realOr(cwd)])]`. Check in this order, returning the first hit:
  1. For each `t` of `bases`: if `secretName(t)` gives `k`, return W2('Grep', `k`).
  2. For each `t`: if `under(t, home + '/.claude')`, return W2('Grep', 'signin').
  3. `main = mainRoot(rr)`. When `main === null` or `!under(main, bases.at(-1))`, return W5(`p ?? norm(cwd)`). `bases.at(-1)` is the real path when it exists (`targets` order), else the lexical one, so a link inside the repo to an outside folder is refused and a link from outside into the repo is allowed (Q-0462 (a)).
  4. When `str(ti.glob)` is set, for each piece `q` of `pieces(ti.glob)` and each `t`: `r = globReach(t, q, { tool: 'Grep', home, repoRoot: rr })`. `'unreadable'` → W3('Grep', `q`); a kind → W2('Grep', `r`).
- **H3 Glob**: `p` and `bases` as in H2. Check in this order:
  1. `secretName(t)` gives `k` → W2('Glob', `k`).
  2. `pat = str(ti.pattern)`. If `pat` is `null`, return `null`. For each piece `q` of `pieces(pat)` and each `t`: `globReach(t, q, { tool: 'Glob', home, repoRoot: rr })` → W3 or W2 as in H2.
- **H4** Any other tool, or no hit → `null`.

**Texts** (section 6; `<what>` = `kindText[k]`):
- **W1** `` `Reading secret files is not allowed: ${given} is ${what} (Q-0459).` ``
- **W2** `` `Searching secret files is not allowed: this ${tool} can reach ${what} (Q-0459). Search a folder or a pattern that cannot match it.` ``
- **W3** `` `Searching secret files is not allowed: this ${tool} pattern cannot be checked: ${q} (Q-0459). Use a pattern without backslashes, extended globs or unbalanced brackets or braces.` `` Here `q` is the piece as typed, before folding.
- **W5** `` `Searching outside the repository is not allowed: this Grep searches ${where} (Q-0462). Search a folder inside the repository or a ticket worktree.` `` Here `where` is the `path` as typed, or `norm(cwd)` when no path is given.
- **W4** (in guard-reads) `` `The secret-file check could not run (${msg}); this ${tool} call is refused (Q-0459).` ``

**X1** (guard-reads.mjs): inside the top-level `try`, directly after `const tool = input.tool_name;`:
`if (tool === 'Read' || tool === 'Grep' || tool === 'Glob') { let why = null; try { const { secretReason } = await import('./secret-paths.mjs'); why = secretReason(tool, input.tool_input || {}, input.cwd || projectDir()); } catch (e) { why = W4 with msg = e && e.message ? e.message : String(e); } if (why) deny(why); }`
The existing Read size check and Bash code that follow stay as they are. `projectDir` is already imported.

**C1** (top of secret-paths.mjs): `// Secret files for guard-reads.mjs (EZD-279; Q-0459 (b)): .env files (not .env.example), scripts/launcher.config.json and the Claude sign-in file, in folded case on every disk (pathKey(p, true)); glob name parts match as typed, case-insensitively. Grep and Glob are judged on folder and pattern (ripgrep -g overrides .gitignore; plan EZD-279 section 2); a Grep outside the main checkout and its ticket worktrees is refused (Q-0462 (a)).`
**C2** (guard-reads.mjs): the first comment line becomes `// PreToolUse on Read, Bash, Grep and Glob: a Read, Grep or Glob that names or can reach a secret file is denied first, failing closed (secret-paths.mjs, EZD-279). A text file over GUARD_WHOLE_READ_CHARS is not loaded whole; the caller gets its outline`. The rest of that comment block is unchanged.

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Letter case | Always folded (`pathKey(p, true)`); `caseInsensitiveDisk` is not used | ticket row; rule 18; a disk-dependent fold fails AC-1 on CI's case-sensitive Linux disk |
| Secret set | S1-S3; `.env.example` is never secret | ticket row; settings.json `Read(...)` denies; guard-paths.mjs `isEnv` and guard-bash.mjs `(?!\.example)`; S3 mirrors guard-bash.mjs `\.claude\/\.cred` |
| Links | Lexical and real path both judged (`targets`). Hard links and links inside a searched tree need a shell `ln`; EZD-280 makes the shell guard refuse any `ln` or `cp` naming a secret | EZD-260; Q-0461 (a) |
| `~` | `~` and `~/…` expand to `os.homedir()`, which reads `HOME` per call | settings.json `Read(~/.claude/.credentials.json)` |
| Grep without a glob | Only H2 steps 2 and 3: in a git repo ripgrep skips gitignored files (in a worktree by its own `.gitignore`; from the main root it skips `.claude/worktrees/`), and every S1/S2 file is gitignored; outside a repo it does not, so every Grep outside the repository is refused | R-045 #6; probes B, E; `.gitignore` 7, 8, 10, 14; Q-0462 (a) |
| Repository for Grep | `mainRoot(repoRoot())`, ticket worktrees inside. `repoRoot() === null` refuses every Grep (fail closed) | EZD-260 `repoRoot`; EZD-250 D1a; rule 18 |
| Outside check order | After H2 steps 1-2 (their more exact W2 texts win: `/` and `~` stay W2 sign-in), before the glob step | L-004; T9 |
| Grep glob | Judged by P. A matching `-g` include overrides `.gitignore`, and `*` matches a leading dot | probe A |
| Negated globs, `type` | A piece starting with `!` selects nothing. `ti.type` is not judged | probe C |
| Glob tool | Same rule P (names only, but the row requires it) | ticket row; R-045 #7 |
| Glob depth | Grep is always deep (ripgrep recurses). A Glob is deep only when a folder part holds a wildcard or `**` | probe A; P3 |
| Case in globs | Matched as typed, never folded first: a token accepts a character when it accepts any case of it (`accept`, P5, with a case-sensitive and an `iu` RegExp); ripgrep globs are case-sensitive, so this only refuses more. Folder and dir compares stay folded | review round 1 finding 1; security round 2 (`[!E]`); probe D; rule 18 |
| Env names in globs | Exact (P6, `prefixHit`): a name part reaches `'env'` when it can match `.env` or any name starting `.env.` other than `.env.example`, in any folder (S1 makes `app/src/.env.ts` secret). No probe list (`ENV_PROBES` dropped) | Josh 2026-11-04 (chat, EZD-279 review round 1 finding 2); S1 |
| Bad class | A RegExp that throws in `compile` (reversed range `[z-a]`) → `'unreadable'` (W3) | review round 1 finding 3; rule 18 |
| Brace limit | 64 expanded alternatives; above that → `'unreadable'` | planner (how to build; bounded work per hook call) |
| Piece split | `pieces()` on Grep `glob` and Glob `pattern`; splitting only adds denies | R-045 #1-#4 (format not documented); rule 18 |
| Errors | A throw inside `secretReason`, or a failed load of `secret-paths.mjs` (dynamic import in X1), → deny W4 (fail closed). The existing size guard keeps its fail-open `catch` | rule 18; review round 1 finding 4; guard-reads.mjs (existing) |
| Known costs | Refused: every Grep outside the repository, `/tmp` included; every Grep glob and Glob pattern whose name part can match a `.env` name, in every folder: `*`, `*.ts`, `*.json`, `**/*.md`, and `*.ts` in `app/src` too. Agents start the name part with something that is not a dot (`[!.]*.ts`, `[a-z]*.json`) or name the file | Josh 2026-11-04 (finding 2); Q-0462 (a); rule 18 |
| Deny list in settings.json | Unchanged; the hook is the backstop | Q-0459 (b); ticket row |
| Bash reads | Unchanged here (guard-bash.mjs owns the shell); EZD-280 closes the shell gaps on `secretName` | Q-0461 (a) |
| Matcher | `Read\|Bash\|Grep\|Glob` (an exact-name list) | R-045 #13 |
| Who writes what | Orchestrator in fix mode: Build steps 1-3 (the EZD-267 grants were removed in 26ba6dee, REMEDIATION 2.8). Test-author: the test file and the T13 edit | L-002; guard-paths.mjs `fixMode` (orchestrator rule) and `isTest` (test-author rule); Josh 2026-11-04 |

### Do not touch
`lib.mjs` (all exports, EZD-260/EZD-277); everything in guard-reads.mjs outside the new import, X1 and C2; `guard-bash.mjs`, `guard-paths.mjs`; every `permissions` entry and every other hook entry in `settings.json`; every existing test except the T13 edit.

Ticket row: `vault/tickets/phases/phase-01.md` EZD-279 (scope Q-0459 (b); Done when = AC-1 to AC-3; Depends on EZD-277).

## 2. Sources
- Q-0459 (b), `vault/questions/QUESTIONS-answered.md` (security-reviewer): the backstop, Grep, Glob and `.env.*`. Q-0462 (a) (security-reviewer): refuse every Grep outside the repository, ticket worktrees inside. Q-0461 (a): the shell-guard gaps are EZD-280, not this ticket. Josh 2026-11-04 (chat): unfrozen, built in fix mode (rule 19). Q-0458 (a): sign-in pattern case (EZD-277 B1). Q-0135 (a) and Q-0361 (b): the shell guard is an accident guard (KNOWN-LIMITS).

## 7. Security review
security-review: yes. Areas: auth (the Claude sign-in file), data access (secret files: `.env`, launcher config), permissions (`.claude/settings.json` hook registration).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer yes.
## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: a security hook on every Read, Grep and Glob with a glob reader whose gaps leak secrets (L-006, EZD-148). Suggested test-author Sonnet 5.5 (medium); builder: the interactive orchestrator (Opus 5.5) in fix mode (Josh 2026-11-04).

## 9. Dependencies
- EZD-277 (ticket row): `pathKey` (D2), stable for EZD-279 (its section 3). Done (41de137d).

- No visual checklist, so EZD-016a is not needed.
- Risks: a bug in X1 denies every Read in the worktree (T6 catches it at the gate). Per call: two `realpathSync` calls and at most 64 small regexes.

## 10. Open questions
None. Answered:
- Q-0461 (a): the shell-guard gaps are fix ticket EZD-280 (depends on this one, on `secretName`); this plan does not change `guard-bash.mjs`.
- Q-0462 (a): every Grep whose folder is outside the repository (ticket worktrees inside) is denied: `mainRoot`, H2 step 3, W5, T15. Cost: no Grep of other folders, `/tmp` included.

# EZD-268 · Fix: a failed unit or role goes up the model ladder before a ticket is set aside or the launcher waits

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-268-1, AC-EZD-268-2, AC-EZD-268-3, AC-EZD-268-4, AC-EZD-268-5
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** tooling, scripts, process
- **User-visible result:** a unit or agent that fails is tried again on a stronger model (up to Fable) before a ticket is set aside or the launcher waits, and Josh hears about it once, with the models tried.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-10-29 · Re-validated: 2026-11-04 on develop `88bbadd7` · Status: ready

## 1. What to build

Terms (PROCESS-EZDRAFT.md s8):
- **Ladder:** `ladderModels(B)` = haiku → sonnet → opus → fable from base B up, padded with fable to 3 entries. **Fable fallback:** a Fable rung runs opus when `EZD_FABLE_ALLOWED` is `0` or after a Fable limit (Q-0004).
- **Key:** `<unit> <arg>` (sequential `next`; lane `key`, run.mjs:650); one map for both paths.
- **Failed try:** outcome not `ok`, `limit-*` or `dry-run`; or `ok` without progress (sequential: run.mjs:812; lanes: `unitProgress`, run.mjs:562).
- **Ticket units** `build`, `plan`; **launcher-wide units** `questions`, `review-plans`, `gate-phase`, `wrap`; `repair` per D5.
- **Outcome text** `o`: ok-no-progress → `ended ok but changed nothing in STATUS.md`; else `r.outcome` + `: <r.note>` when set; cleaned (`|` → `/`, CR/LF/tab runs → one space, cut to 200; EZD-265 D5).

| 2 | `vault/tools/next_ticket.mjs` | change | `dispatchFor(id, role, round = 1)` new result (section 3); `M` = `MODEL_IDS` (line 608); `fableOr` (609) and the round ladder (621-631) removed; usage line 16 adds `round, final` | `dispatchFor` itself (616-652) | `node --test scripts/ledger/dispatch-ladder.test.mjs` |
| 3 | `scripts/launcher-idle.mjs` | change | `repairDecision({ next, state, consecutive, tries = 1 })` (line 46); add `ladderWaiting(wait, now)`; remove `createGuards`, `guardAfterUnit` (163-191) | `repairDecision` | `node --test scripts/launcher/ladder.test.mjs scripts/launcher/recovery.test.mjs scripts/launcher/lanes.test.mjs` |

| 5 | `scripts/watchdog.mjs` | change | `decide` returns `{ status: 'ladder-wait', why: W7 }` when `!unitRunning && st.state === 'ladder-wait'`, right after the `repair-failed` return (lines 45-46) | that `repair-failed` return | `node --test scripts/launcher/ladder.test.mjs scripts/process/watchdog.test.mjs` |

Step 4, in order (L-004; each early return is an s8 KEEP stop):
- D1 State, in `main` beside line 514: `ladderFile = path.join(logDir, 'ladder-state.json')`; `let ladder = continuous ? readJson(ladderFile, {}) : {}` (non-object or array → `{}`; drop entries that are not plain objects with `base` in `LADDER`, `models` string array, `outcomes` array). `saveLadder()` = `writeFileSync(ladderFile, JSON.stringify(ladder) + '\n')` in try/catch → log `ladder state not written: <message>`. `let fableOut = false`. Remove `noProgress` (515), `guards` (523), `main.retried` (834-846) and the `createGuards`/`guardAfterUnit` import (70); keep `tabled` (516) as the one three-in-a-row count for both paths.

## 6. Proposed wording
`<models>` = model ids joined ` → `; `<o>` = clean outcome text; `<d>` = `YYYY-MM-DD`.
| Where | Text |

| W1 notice | `<next> failed after the model ladder (models tried: <models>; last outcome: <o>). The launcher waits and tries again when STATUS.md, the next unit or the launcher code changes.` |
| W2 notice | `<T> tabled (blocked) after the model ladder (models tried: <models>; last outcome: <o>); the launcher goes on with the next ticket. See vault/tickets/STATUS.md.` |
| W3 notice | `unit <next> failed after the model ladder (models tried: <models>; last outcome: <o>); launcher stopped. See vault/handoff/CURRENT.md.` |
| W4 notice | `repair failed for "<wait>" after the model ladder (models tried: <models>): <line>. The launcher keeps waiting and re-checks. See vault/handoff/REPAIR.md.` |

| LG2 log | `<subject>: Fable limit; this try runs again on claude-opus-5-5 (Fable fallback)` (`<subject>` = `unitSubject(next, repair)` sequential, `key` in lanes; Q-0470) |
| LG3 log | `<next> failed after the model ladder; waiting for STATUS.md, the next unit or the launcher code to change` |
| LG4 log | `ladder wait for <next> ended; starting again on <base>` |
| LG5 log | `repair <kind> failed on <model> (try <k> of <n>): <line>; next try on <model'>` |

## 7. Security review
security-review: no (launcher and ledger tooling; no auth, permissions, data access, app money or API).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer always · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier no · security-reviewer no.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
high: it rewrites the failure, no-progress and repair paths of both launcher paths, adds persisted state and reroutes every dispatch. Test-author Sonnet 5.5 / medium; builder (fix-mode orchestrator) Opus 5.5 / medium (PROCESS.md section 4).

- Not in the ticket row (say so): EZD-174 (done, `9b6706e3`, `7533427f`: lanes, per-key guards), ad15eed6 (set-aside, fix mode) and f82b0110 (records database); all merged.

Decided (Josh 2026-11-04, chat): option (a) of the re-validation question. After the ladder a build or plan unit is set aside with today's `setAside` (a plan unit goes on `.git/set-aside.json` with notice W8), and a launcher-wide unit makes the launcher wait with W1 (s8, AC-EZD-268-2). # EZD-330 · Fix: the Projects page tabs and other controls meet the 44 px touch-target check

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-330-1
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** ui, testing, tokens
- **User-visible result:** on the Projects page every status tab, the sort button and each sort menu option can be tapped across a 44 px area, the page looks as on board S01, and develop's CI is green again.
- Phase: 2 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build
Data: none.

Cause (read from merged code): EZD-289 E1 (`app/e2e/home-settings.spec.ts:20`) runs `expectTouchTargets(page, page.locator('main'))` (`app/test-harness/touch-targets.ts`) at the desktop project (1600 × 1000, fine pointer). `touch.module.css` `.target`/`.hitArea` apply only under `@media (any-pointer: coarse)`, so on desktop `.tab` (padding 7px, 13px text: 30 px tall, ticket row) and `.sortButton` (padding 9px + 18 px icon + 2px border: under 44) fail. `.menuItem` (padding 10px, 14px text) is under 44 too. Settings link and Sign out already have `min-height: 44px` (`Projects.module.css .settingsLink`; `auth.module.css .secondary`). Cards hold no control (`ProjectCard.tsx`; Q-0394).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `app/src/components/projects/Projects.module.css` | change | none (CSS module classes `.tab`, `.sortButton`, `.menuItem` keep their names) | `app/src/styles/touch.module.css` `.hitArea` / `.hitArea::after` (same `min(0px, calc(50% - var(--ez-touch-target) / 2))` offsets, here outside any media query and with `- 2px`) | `node scripts/ui-run.mjs EZD-330 e2e/projects-touch.spec.ts` (T1–T3 pass) |
| 2 | `docs/architecture.md` section `### Device layouts (EZD-014)`, bullet "44 px targets" | change | none | the bullet itself | `node --test scripts/conventions/__tests__/device-layouts-doc.test.mjs` |
| 3 | (verify only) | none | none | none | `node scripts/ui-run.mjs EZD-330 e2e/home-settings.spec.ts` (E1–E3 pass), `node scripts/ui-run.mjs EZD-330 e2e/projects.spec.ts` (B1–B8 pass), then `node scripts/gate.mjs .claude/worktrees/EZD-330` |

Step 3 is required: EZD-289 is phase 1, so the EZD-330 ticket gate (phase 2 + `@smoke`, architecture `### Test scope (Q-0006)`) does not run E1; only the full suite does.

### Decided for the builder
| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Which pointers | The rules below apply with every pointer (no media query). | Ticket row Scope ("every control on the Projects page", checked by E1 at desktop) |
| Look kept | Visible padding, font, colors, radii and borders of `.tab` and `.sortButton` do not change; the extra area is an invisible pseudo-element. | Ticket row ("keeping the look of board S01Projects"); board `.ft` `padding:7px 12px`, `.b` `padding:9px 14px` (`vault/mockups/html/project/S01Projects.dc.html` lines 19, 23) |
| `.tab` additions | `position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; min-width: var(--ez-touch-target); justify-content: center;` Keep every existing declaration (`align-items: baseline`, padding, font, color). | min-width covers "All" before counts load (text plus 24 px padding is under 44); `--ez-touch-target` = 44px (`app/src/styles/tokens.css:44`) |
| `.sortButton` addition | `position: relative;` | containing block for `::after` |
| Hit area rule | One new rule `.tab::after, .sortButton::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: H; bottom: H; left: H; right: H; }` with H = `min(0px, calc(50% - var(--ez-touch-target) / 2 - 2px))`. No background, no z-index. | `touch.module.css .hitArea::after` pattern; the `- 2px` gives a 48 px area so the check's whole-pixel reach from a fractional centre (`touch-targets.ts` `reach`, `hh = left + right + 1`) cannot round a fractional-height box down to 43 |
| Horizontal overlap | Only a tab narrower than 48 px gets a side extension (at most 2 px, into the 2 px `.tabs` gap or the 4 px `.tabs` padding); wider tabs and the sort button extend only up and down. No change to `.tabs` gap or padding. | `.tabs` (`gap: 2px; padding: 4px`) |
| `.menuItem` additions | `box-sizing: border-box; min-height: var(--ez-touch-target);` and change `align-items: flex-start` to `align-items: center`. Items are adjacent in the menu column, so an invisible extension would overlap the next item; a real 44 px row is the only way. Center: sort labels are single-line (`PROJECT_SORTS`, `app/src/lib/projects/projects.ts:16`), and board `.b` centers its label. | S01 Controls (sort menu is a Projects page control); 11 Accessibility and input |
| Comment | Add one CSS comment line above the new `::after` rule: `EZD-330: 44 px tap areas with every pointer (11 Accessibility; EZD-289 E1 checks at desktop).` | — |
| Doc line (step 2) | Append to the "44 px targets" bullet: `The Projects page tabs and sort button add an invisible 48 px hit area and its sort menu items are 44 px tall with every pointer (\`Projects.module.css\`, EZD-330), because EZD-289 E1 runs the check there at desktop size.` Keep every existing term in the bullet. | `scripts/conventions/__tests__/device-layouts-doc.test.mjs` D1 (c) needs `any-pointer: coarse`, `--ez-touch-target`, `expectTouchTargets` to stay |
| New spec file | `app/e2e/projects-touch.spec.ts`, its own file with its own `test.afterAll` (`cleanup()` then `closeHarness()` in `finally`), not a describe in `projects.spec.ts` (that file's `afterAll` closes the harness). Untagged = desktop only. | `app/e2e/projects.spec.ts` lines 20–45, 81–88; architecture `### Browser tests (EZD-016a)` routing by tags |

### Do not touch
`app/src/styles/touch.module.css` and `touch-css.test.ts` (EZD-014b pins its rules); `ProjectsView.tsx`, `ProjectCard.tsx`, `Menu.tsx`, `page.tsx` (markup, testids and the coarse `touch.target` classes stay); `app/test-harness/touch-targets.ts`; `app/e2e/home-settings.spec.ts` and `projects.spec.ts` (no edits; they must pass as they are); every other class in `Projects.module.css`.

Ticket row (phase-01.md): **Scope** Since EZD-117a (f880bc59) made `/` the Projects page, EZD-289's home-page spec E1 runs the EZD-014c touch-target check over it and fails: the tab buttons have 30 px tall tap areas (develop CI run 41925378649, red at 88bbadd7). Every control on the Projects page gets a tap area of at least 44 px (11 Non-functional requirements), keeping the look of board S01Projects. **Done when** EZD-289 E1 passes: the touch-target check over the Projects page lists no failure, and the page still matches the EZD-117a visual checklist. **Depends on** EZD-117a, EZD-289. **Spec ref** CLAUDE.md rule 17; 11 Non-functional requirements (44 px).

## 2. Sources
- `vault/spec/sections/11-non-functional-requirements.md` · Accessibility and input ("iPad touch targets at least 44 px").
- `vault/spec/sections/screens/S01-projects.md` · Controls (status tabs, sort button and sort menu), Layout (title row).
- Mockup `vault/mockups/S01Projects.png`; HTML `vault/mockups/html/project/S01Projects.dc.html` (`.b` line 19, `.ft` line 23, `.mi` line 32).
- Decisions: none for this ticket (`--reads` lists none); Q-0055, Q-0245 (touch and hover rules) do not conflict. No non-goal or glossary entry applies.
- Merged code: `app/test-harness/touch-targets.ts` (EZD-014c), `app/e2e/home-settings.spec.ts` (EZD-289), `app/src/components/projects/{ProjectsView.tsx,ProjectCard.tsx,Projects.module.css}`, `app/src/app/(office)/page.tsx` (EZD-117a), `app/src/components/menu/Menu.tsx` (EZD-108), `app/src/styles/touch.module.css`, `app/test-harness/projects-fixture.ts`. EZD-117a plan sections 3 and 5 (testids, visual checklist).
- No research report covers this ticket.

Architecture: Device layouts (EZD-014); Browser tests (EZD-016a)

## 3. Interface contract
| Kind | Name or path | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| file | `app/e2e/projects-touch.spec.ts` | new; top-level `test.describe('EZD-330 Projects page touch targets', …)` (C9) |
| import | `../test-harness/e2e/test` | `cleanup, closeHarness, createMember, createTenant, expect, expectTouchTargets, setPermissions, test` |

| data-testid | existing (EZD-117a section 3) | `projects-tab-all`, `projects-tab-draft`, `projects-tab-client_review`, `projects-tab-permit_submitted`, `projects-tab-approved`, `projects-tab-in_build`, `projects-tab-count`, `projects-sort`, `projects-sort-menu`, `project-card` |

| CSS classes | `Projects.module.css` `.tab`, `.sortButton`, `.menuItem` | names unchanged; additions per section 1 |

## 4. Tests
Fixture S = new tenant + `seedFixtureS` + a member with only `view_projects`; signed in; `page.goto('/')`. Expected counts: 6 tabs (`PROJECT_TABS`, `projects.ts:14`; EZD-117a U8) + 1 sort trigger (`Menu` `<button>`, `ProjectsView.tsx`) + 1 Sign out (`page.tsx` actions) = 8; no Settings link because `view_projects` opens no Settings section (`mayOpenSettings`, `app/src/lib/settings/sections.ts:143`); the sort menu is portalled to `body` and absent while closed (`Menu.tsx`), cards hold no control, fixture S has 6 projects so no `projects-more` sentinel.

| Test | AC | Type | Input | Expected value | Source of the expected value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 EZD-330 counts shown: every control in main passes the touch-target check and keeps the board padding | AC-EZD-330-1 | browser | Fixture S; wait for `projects-tab-count` `toHaveText(['6','2','1','1','1','1'])` | `expectTouchTargets(page, page.locator('main'))` resolves to `8`; each of the 6 `projects-tab-*` tabs `toHaveCSS('padding-top','7px')` and `toHaveCSS('padding-left','12px')`; `projects-sort` `toHaveCSS('padding-top','9px')` and `toHaveCSS('padding-left','14px')` | counts: EZD-117a B5 on fixture S; 8: section 4 lead; 44 px: 11 Accessibility; paddings: board `.ft`, `.b` (S01Projects.dc.html lines 23, 19) |
| T2 EZD-330 before counts load: the All tab still passes | AC-EZD-330-1 | browser | Fixture S; `page.route('**/api/projects/counts', (r) => r.abort())` before `goto`; wait for `project-card` `toHaveCount(6)` | `projects-tab-count` `toHaveCount(0)`; `expectTouchTargets(page, page.locator('main'))` resolves to `8` | `ProjectsView.tsx` renders the count only when `counts !== null`; store sets only `countsStatus: 'error'` on failure (`projects-store.ts:97`); 6 cards: fixture S All count 6 |
| T3 EZD-330 sort menu items pass the touch-target check | AC-EZD-330-1 | browser | Fixture S; click `projects-sort`; wait for `projects-sort-menu` visible | `expectTouchTargets(page, page.getByTestId('projects-sort-menu'))` resolves to `5` | `PROJECT_SORTS` has 5 entries (`projects.ts:16`); `MenuItem` is a `<button>` (`Menu.tsx`) |

# EZD-117b · Projects page: header, search and states

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-117b-1, AC-EZD-117b-2, AC-EZD-117b-3, AC-EZD-117b-4, AC-EZD-117b-5, AC-EZD-117b-6
- **Complexity:** high
- **Areas:** ui, testing, migrations, security, data-model
- **User-visible result:** Projects has its header (wordmark, search with the / key, bell, settings gear, avatar menu), search that narrows the cards and the tab counts, and the empty, no-match, loading, error, no-access and offline states.
- Phase: 2 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-10-29 · Status: planned · Plan gap 2026-11-04: E6–E9 · Plan gap 2026-11-04 (round 2): E4 rewritten, E10 added, Q-0579 (budget) · Re-validated 2026-11-05 against EZD-332 (26e41274) and Q-0579 (b) · Plan gap 2026-11-05 (round 3): E11, `.loadError`, QP-1 (budget measured)

## 1. What to build

Data: no table or column. M3 re-creates P117a's two `security invoker` functions with `p_search` (RLS unchanged, P117a "Visible projects"). M1/M2 plus these edits ran on the pinned stack (PostgreSQL 17.11) in a rolled-back transaction, 2026-10-29 (L-009): client and address matches, case-insensitive, literal `%`/`_`, null and `''` = all, tab + search combined.

M3 `supabase/migrations/<ts>_add_project_search.sql`, in this order:
1. `drop function public.list_projects(text, text, jsonb);` then P117a M1 verbatim with three edits: signature `(p_sort text, p_status text default null, p_after jsonb default null, p_search text default '')`; a first CTE `term as (select replace(replace(replace(btrim(coalesce(p_search, '')), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') as t),` before `base`; in `base`, `cross join term` after the `left join public.customer c …` line and one more `where` condition `and (term.t = '' or p.name ilike '%' || term.t || '%' or p.address ilike '%' || term.t || '%' or c.name ilike '%' || term.t || '%')`. Then `revoke all on function public.list_projects(text, text, jsonb, text) from public, anon, service_role; grant execute on function public.list_projects(text, text, jsonb, text) to authenticated;`
2. `drop function public.count_projects();` then P117a M2 with: signature `(p_search text default '')`; body prefixed `with term as (<same select>)`; `from public.project p left join public.customer c on c.id = p.customer_id cross join term`; `where p.archived_at is null and (<same search condition>)`. Then revoke/grant on `public.count_projects(text)` as above (L-016).
Header comment cites this plan. `language sql stable security invoker set search_path = ''` as in M1/M2 (lesson EZD-018).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `supabase/migrations/<ts>_add_project_search.sql` (`pnpm supabase migration new add_project_search`; `<ts>` newer than develop's newest file) | new | M3 | `supabase/migrations/20261026233829_create_list_customers.sql` (`term` CTE) | `pnpm db:up`; D1 |
| 2 | `app/src/server/db/database.types.ts` | regenerate | `pnpm db:types` (Args gain `p_search?: string`) | ARCH Local database | `node scripts/db/gen-types.mjs --check` |

security-review: yes — data access, API, migrations (two `security invoker` functions dropped and re-created with grants; new `q` input on two routes; header reads `app_user`).
Reviewers needed: code-reviewer yes · calc-auditor no · ui-verifier yes · security-reviewer yes.

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: a migration that redefines two functions, a debounced store change, a header joining two in-flight dependencies, eleven browser tests and edits to five earlier specs. Test-author Opus 5.5; builder Opus 5.5.

## 9. Dependencies
Depends on (tickets.json): EZD-117a, EZD-015a, 015b, 015c (done), EZD-108 (`AvatarMenu`, `settings` icon, `office.account.company_settings`), EZD-110a, EZD-110b (`NotificationBell`), EZD-332 (done, 26e41274: bell list code loaded on first open, zod out of the browser; Q-0579 (b)). Missing from the row: EZD-016a (browser harness; visual checklist). Done and used: EZD-102, EZD-103a, EZD-113, EZD-289 (Settings link tests, E6, E7), EZD-321 (`CAP_LOCK_READ_ONLY`, E8).
Risks: the bell adds two `GET /api/notifications` and one `GET /api/realtime/token` on load (EZD-110b D16; `hub.ts`), so 117a's B1 expects five `/api/` requests and B4 nine (E4, E10; AC-EZD-117a-2 counts the two project data requests, Q-0450 (a)); `captureTraffic` breaks the Realtime websocket in Chrome (E4), so no spec here counts bell requests under it (debt row for the orchestrator: `app/test-harness/e2e/traffic.ts`, medium); `projects-first-cards-ms` stays `pending` until EZD-276 (Q-0449 (a)); 117a's B3 fails the 220,000 budget (Q-0579 (b)): measured 2026-11-05 by gzip level 6 (`scripts/perf/budgets.mjs` `compressedSize`) of `build-manifest.json` `rootMainFiles` plus the `(office)/page` and layout `entryJSFiles`, develop 3a82ae2f `/` = 195,708; this branch (5211d90a) = 231,351 (the gate's 231,714 less the builder's 375-byte cut); the same branch with `<NotificationBell />` removed from `ProjectsHeader` = 198,401. So the bell adds 32,950 (Realtime chunk 18,483, bell + Radix popover chunk 13,885, wiring 582) and the header, avatar menu, search and states add 2,693. The 216,800 estimate (Q-0579) subtracted the bell code (14,901) as if "list on first open" removed it, but the list view is only about 1,500 (the lazy chunk); the popover library and trigger still load on mount. Only zod's 30,852 came off (262,587 − 30,852 = 231,735). No cut inside this ticket closes 11,351 (the ticket's own code is 2,693): QP-1; M3 drops 117a's functions, allowed only while no release tag holds them (ARCH Release safety), so 117a and 117b ship in the same release; until EZD-118 the New project button does nothing.

## 10. Open questions
Q-0448, Q-0449 and Q-0450 are answered (2026-10-30) and applied above. Q-0579 (b) is reopened on new facts:
- QP-1 (Josh; reopens Q-0579, answered (b) on an estimate of about 216,800 that measurement now disproves): with the zod fix (EZD-332) merged, the Projects page measures 231,351 compressed bytes against the 220,000 budget; develop's page without the header is 195,708, the header without the bell is 198,401, and the live bell adds 32,950 (live-update connection 18,483, bell and its popup 13,885), so nothing inside this ticket closes the 11,351 gap. Options: (a) raise the Projects budget to 240,000 (about 8,600 of room; no work; the page stays about 15% over the spec's 200 KB); (b) a further fix ticket that slims the bell (replace the Radix popup with a lighter one, saving part of 13,885, not measured; the live-update part cannot shrink without making the bell non-live), likely still over 220,000; (c) take the bell off the Projects header (198,401, within even the original 200,000; the bell then lives on other pages only, and B1/B4/E4/E10/E11 are re-planned). Recommended (a): smallest change that keeps the live bell Josh chose in Q-0579; cost is a heavier first load on slow connections.

# EZD-120d · Sign-out with queued edits, app-wide drain and the test page

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-120d-1, AC-EZD-120d-2, AC-EZD-120d-3, AC-EZD-120d-4, AC-EZD-120d-5
- **Complexity:** medium
- **Areas:** auth, ui, testing, data-model
- **User-visible result:** Sign out sends unsaved edits first or asks before leaving them on the device; no one else signing in there sends them; preview test page `/dev/saves/<project id>`.
- Phase: 3 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned; re-validated 2026-11-05 against merged EZD-120b (e8e27a5b), EZD-120c (2d5ed1f0); plan gap 2026-11-05: EZD-203 (0f726433) wall `layers`; review fixes 2026-11-05 (build round 3): Q-0599 `__Host-` marker, bench baseline, drain import failure, redirect rethrow

## 1. What to build

| Offline sign-out | `signOutOnDevice`: `action()` resolves → nothing; rejects with a Next redirect error (`digest` a string starting `NEXT_REDIRECT`, the real sign-out: `signOut` ends `redirect('/sign-in')`, `app/src/server/auth/actions.ts:284`) → rethrow that error unchanged, no marker, no `replace` (Next performs the redirect); any other rejection (server unreachable) → `location.protocol === 'https:'` writes `__Host-ezd_signed_out=1; Path=/; Secure; Max-Age=34560000; SameSite=Lax`, else `ezd_signed_out=1; Path=/; Max-Age=34560000; SameSite=Lax` (name from `signedOutCookieName`), then `location.replace('/sign-in')` and resolves. Every sign-out from both buttons (CLAUDE.md rule 18) | Q-0581; Q-0599; Q-0048 (a) (400 days); `node_modules/next/dist/client/components/redirect-error.js:24-33` (digest format) |
| Signed-out marker | `proxy()` first: `https = isForwardedHttps(request)`; marker = `signedOutCookieName(https)`; only that name counts: on https a plain `ezd_signed_out` is ignored entirely (not deleted, no `sb-` touched, `getClaims` runs as today), on http a `__Host-ezd_signed_out` likewise. Request has the marker → `request.cookies.delete` each name starting `sb-` and the marker, before `NextResponse.next({ request })`; skip `getClaims` (signed out); the result (307 `/sign-in` off `PUBLIC_PATHS`, else next) sets each deleted name `''` with `{ path: '/', maxAge: 0 }` on http, `{ path: '/', maxAge: 0, secure: true }` on https, and `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. | `check()` | no actor or `countQueued` 0 → true; else `loadOfficeDrain()`: null (import failed) → `kept`; else `sendBeforeSignOut(actor, handle)`: `sent` → true; `kept` → dialog (both buttons; confirm true, Cancel/Esc false) | Q-0503; code review 2026-11-05 finding C |
| Dialog | hook owns `createConfirmController()` and renders `ConfirmDialog` (T9 has no provider); section 6 keys, cancel `common.cancel`, tone `danger` (11 Offline) | EZD-015b |
| `sendBeforeSignOut` | `h = handle ?? startDrain(actor)`; race `h.sync.flush()` with `waitMs` (10,000; build choice, Q-0507); `h.storage.list()` empty → `sent`, else or throw → `kept`; dispose `h` if made here; never deletes edits | Q-0503 |

# EZD-280 · Fix: the shell guard denies any command that names a secret file, whatever the command word

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-280-1, AC-EZD-280-2, AC-EZD-280-3
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** tooling, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** no agent can read, copy or link the `.env` files, the launcher's config or the Claude sign-in file from the shell with any command word, in any letter case.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-10-30, re-validated 2026-11-04 on develop dfe0af6d (EZD-279 merged 1b320982) · Status: ready

## 1. What to build
Base: develop dfe0af6d (EZD-279 merged 1b320982). This plan adds code inside the merged `.claude/hooks/secret-paths.mjs` and uses its names: exports `secretName(abs)`, `globReach(root, glob, ctx)`; module-private `targets(given, cwd, home)`, `realOr(p)`, `kindText`, and the imports `norm`, `repoRoot`, `os` (EZD-279 section 3, "stable for EZD-280"). Merged `globReach` already treats every tool other than `'Grep'` as `'Glob'` for base and depth (its `else base = …` branch and `deep = ctx.tool === 'Grep' || D.some(wild)`), and its name tokens accept a character as typed, in either case or folded (`tk.accept`; negated classes do not narrow); E1 relies on both and changes neither. Steps name code text, not line numbers (EZD-155); guard-bash.mjs at dfe0af6d lines 21 and 41 are the `.env` entry of `always` and the sign-in `noTests` deny. Built in fix mode (Josh 2026-11-04; STATUS EZD-280 note "Guarded paths: interactive fix mode"): the interactive orchestrator does Build steps 1-2 while `vault/handoff/LAUNCHER_FIX.md` exists (guard-paths.mjs `fixMode`; PROCESS.md section 3 rule 19); "builder" in this plan means that orchestrator, as in EZD-279.

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `.claude/hooks/secret-paths.mjs` | change | `globReach` ctx becomes `{ tool: 'Grep' \| 'Glob' \| 'Bash', home: string, repoRoot: string \| null }` (rule E1). New `export function shellWords(command)` `(command: string) => { text: string, glob: boolean, unreadable: boolean }[][]` (K1-K8). New `export function shellSecretReason(command, cwd)` `(command: string, cwd: string) => string \| null` (J1-J4, texts B1-B3), placed after `secretReason`. Header comment: C3 as a new line directly after line 1. No new import. | the same file: `secretReason` (per-call `home`, `rr`; first hit returns) | `node --test scripts/hooks/secret-bash.test.mjs scripts/hooks/secret-reads.test.mjs` |
| 2 | `.claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs` | change | none (script). The `./lib.mjs` import gains `projectDir`. No static import of `./secret-paths.mjs`: G1 loads it with `await import()` inside its own `try`, so a missing or broken module gives B4 (the file is an ES module; top-level `await` is allowed). Insert block G1 directly after the sign-in deny statement (the `if` that tests `noTests`). | the merged secret block of `guard-reads.mjs` (EZD-279 X1: `await import('./secret-paths.mjs')` in a `try`, fail-closed `catch`, deny) | `node --test scripts/hooks/secret-bash.test.mjs scripts/hooks/guard-bash.test.mjs scripts/hooks/case-guards.test.mjs` |

**E1 `globReach`, tool `'Bash'`.** Base and depth: no change (merged code already handles `'Bash'` as `'Glob'`: base `/` for an absolute alternative, else `root`; deep only when a folder part holds a wildcard). Dot rule: after `const at = …`, add `const dot = ctx.tool !== 'Bash' || F.startsWith('.');` and prefix the `'env'` line's condition and the `'signin'` line's condition each with `dot && (` … `)`; the `'launcher'` line is unchanged. A shell wildcard or bracket never matches a leading dot (probe F). `'Grep'` and `'Glob'` are unchanged (`dot` is `true`).

**K `shellWords(command)`** (POSIX shell words; KNOWN-LIMITS shell-guard entry). Walk the characters left to right, building one word (`text`, `glob`, `unreadable`) and one command (a list of words).
- **K1** End a word: when `text !== ''`, push it to the command; when `text` is exactly `[`, `[[`, `{`, `}` or `{}`, push it with `glob: false`. Start a new word. End a command: end the word; push the command to the result when it holds a word; start a new command.
- **K2** Unquoted space or tab ends the word. Unquoted `;`, `&`, `|`, `(`, `)`, `<`, `>`, backtick, `\n`, `\r` end the command. `#` is an ordinary character (no comments: zsh without `interactive_comments` runs the rest).
- **K3** Unquoted `\`: followed by `\n` → drop both; followed by any other character → append that character; at the end of input → append `\`.
- **K4** `'`: append every character up to the next `'` as is; no closing `'` → up to the end.
- **K5** `"`: up to the next unescaped `"`. Inside, `\` before `$`, backtick, `"` or `\` appends that character; `\` before `\n` drops both; `\` before any other character appends both. No closing `"` → up to the end.
- **K6** Unquoted `$` directly followed by `'` (ANSI-C quoting): drop the `$`, then up to the next `'` not escaped by `\`. Decode `\\` `\'` `\"` `\?` to the second character, and `\a` `\b` `\e` `\E` `\f` `\n` `\r` `\t` `\v` to their control characters. `\` before a digit, `x`, `u`, `U` or `c` sets `unreadable: true` and appends both characters undecoded. `\` before any other character appends both. Unquoted `$` directly followed by `"`: drop the `$`, then K5.
- **K7** Any other unquoted character is appended. `*`, `?`, `[`, and a `{` not directly after a `$` appended by K7, set `glob: true`. Characters appended by K3-K6 never set `glob`.
- **K8** At the end of input end the command. Return the commands in input order.

**J `shellSecretReason(command, cwd)`**: `home = realOr(os.homedir())`, `rr = repoRoot()`, `roots = [norm(cwd)]`, `cur = norm(cwd)`, `prev = cur`. Return `walkShell(command, 0)`. `walkShell` and `judgeWord` are functions declared inside `shellSecretReason` (named so they do not shadow the module's token `walk`).
- **J1 `walkShell(text, depth)`**: for each command `c` of `shellWords(text)`, in order:
  - Exempt word: `c[2]` when `c` is exactly 3 words `test`, `-f`, W, or exactly 4 words `[`, `-f`, W, `]` (texts compared exactly). Otherwise none.
  - When `c[0].text` is `cd` or `pushd`, with `a` = the last later word whose text does not start with `-`, or the word `-` when it is the only later word: no `a` → `next = home`; `a.text === '-'` → `next = prev`; `a.text` holds `$` or a backtick → `next = cur`; otherwise `next = targets(a.text, cur, home)[0]`. Then `prev = cur`, `cur = next`; push `cur` to `roots` when not already in it. Deliberate (orchestrator, plan-checker gap 2, 2026-11-05): the `cd`/`pushd` step updates `cur` and `roots` before that same command's words are judged; since roots only grow, its own words are judged against both the old and the new roots (the stricter reading).
  - Round 1 security finding 1 (in-place, 2026-11-05): when `a` was chosen and `a.glob` is true, return B2(`a.text`) at any depth, before the folder changes (a wildcard folder cannot be checked: `cd ~/.[c]laude` reaches the sign-in folder).
  - For each word `w` of `c` that is not the exempt word: `r = judgeWord(w, depth)`; a non-null `r` is returned.
  - Return `null`.
- **J2 `judgeWord(w, depth)`**, checks in this order, the first hit returns:
  1. `cands` = `w.text`, then the pieces of `w.text` split at `/[\s=:,]+/`, or at `/[\s=:,{}+-]+/` when `w.text` holds `$` (round 1 code-review note 1, in-place 2026-11-05: a written default `${X:-.env.local}` is judged; a brace word without `$` keeps B3) (empty pieces dropped, repeats dropped). For each `s` of `cands`, each `root` of `roots`, each `t` of `targets(s, root, home)`: `k = secretName(t)` not null → B1(`s`, `k`).
  2. `w.unreadable && depth === 0` → B2(`w.text`).
  3. `w.glob`: `g` = `w.text` with a leading `~` or `~/` replaced by `home` (as `targets`). For each `root`: `r = globReach(root, g, { tool: 'Bash', home, repoRoot: rr })`. A kind → B3(`w.text`, `r`); `'unreadable'` and `depth === 0` → B2(`w.text`).
  4. Re-read, when `w.text` matches the class below and `shellWords(w.text)` is not exactly one command of one word whose text is `w.text` (a re-read that changes nothing stops here): `depth < 3` → `r = walkShell(w.text, depth + 1)`, non-null → return `r`; `depth === 3` → B2(`w.text`) (fail closed past three levels). The class: `/[\s'"\\`$;&|<>()]/`.
- **J3** `roots` and `cur` are shared by every `walkShell` level of one call.
- **J4** No hit → `null`.

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-154-1 (T1), AC-EZD-154-2 (T2), AC-EZD-154-3 (T3); from the Done-when below, via `node vault/tools/gen_acs.mjs`
- **Complexity:** low
- **Areas:** tooling, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** An agent working in one of the old EZD-000b to EZD-000j worktrees can no longer change the agent settings, hooks, CLAUDE.md, scripts or ledger tools; the path guard now matches what PROCESS.md says ("There are no builder grants").

Josh authorized EZD-154 in fix mode (vault/spec/decisions/process.md, 2026-11-05 row). No builder is dispatched.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-10-24 · Status: planned · Re-planned 2026-11-04 (lean process shrink: Block A3 only; the guard-bash work is dropped and kept on branch `t/EZD-154-dropped-guard-bash`, not part of this ticket)

## 1. What to build

Scope (vault/spec/decisions/process.md, 2026-11-04 lean process row: "EZD-154 shrinks to removing the PA3 grant"): delete the PA3 builder grant from `.claude/hooks/guard-paths.mjs` and the tests that pin it. The grant was for the EZD-000b..EZD-000j worktrees and was to be removed "after the last part merges" (Q-0128 (a)); all nine are `done` (vault/tickets/STATUS.md). Grants were removed by REMEDIATION 2.8 / D4 (a) (vault/PROCESS-EZDRAFT.md line 103; vault/PROCESS.md line 619), and Q-0268 sweep item 22 (vault/tickets/sweep-2026-10-24.md) found the code still holds it.

Re-validated against develop `dfe0af6d` (guard-paths.mjs sha256 `20570660f286bc89b0d22cd4f235472621717d7ec18a059f5aadb1f1e6a37a64`). Findings: there is no EZD-173 grant, no `import path` and no `norm` in this file any more, so the old Block A3 line `if (pa3Grant() || ezd173Grant()) return;` does not exist; the builder line is `if (pa3Grant()) return;` (line 93). `realKey` (line 25) is read only by `pa3Worktree` (line 61), so it goes too (Decided, row 2). `real` stays (lines 11, 16, 23 read it).

Prototype (planner, 2026-11-04, scratch copy of the worktree's `.claude/hooks/` and `scripts/hooks/`): with the edits below, T1-T3 and the edited EZD-277 T6 pass; on the unchanged hook T1 and T3 fail and T2 and the fix-mode test pass; the rest of `scripts/hooks/*.test.mjs` gives the same results on both hooks.

# EZD-201 · Length parse and format

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-201-1, AC-EZD-201-2, AC-EZD-201-3, AC-EZD-201-4, AC-EZD-201-5
- **Complexity:** medium (section 8)
- **Areas:** geometry, testing
- **User-visible result:** none on screen yet; the shared length reader and writer that every length box and every drawn dimension will use (typed bar EZD-209, Room rectangle EZD-210, templates EZD-221) exists and is proven against the worked examples.
- Phase: 4 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-04 · Status: planned

## 1. What to build

Data: none (no table, column, migration or `schema_version` change).

### Build steps
| # | Path | New / change | Exports and signatures | Copy the pattern from | Verify with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `packages/geometry/src/length.ts` | new | section 3 rows E1–E9, exactly | `app/src/lib/profile/profile.ts` `parseProfileInput` (pure function returning an `{ ok: true … } \| { ok: false … }` union); no imports at all | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/geometry test` (T1–T16) and `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/geometry typecheck` |
| 2 | `packages/geometry/src/index.ts` | change | add `export * from './length';` (E10) as the file's last line; delete the line `export {};` if present; leave every other line (the header comment, and EZD-202's `export * from` lines if it merged first) as it is. | the file itself | `pnpm --filter @ezdraft/geometry test` (T16 and EZD-001 T1) |
| 3 | `app/src/server/messages/catalogs/en.ts` | change | one new entry, the last entry, on its own line directly above the line `} as const satisfies Record<string, Message>;`: `'office.length.refused': 'Use 12\'6", 12\' 6 1/2", 150" or 12.5\'',` (E11) | the `office.notifications.*` entries above it | `cd app && pnpm exec vitest run src/server/messages/length-message.test.ts src/server/messages/catalog.test.ts` (T17 and the EZD-026 catalog tests) |

Run Prettier on the three files (architecture `Tests`).

### Decided for the builder
`parseLength` algorithm, in this order (D1–D9); `formatLength` (D10–D14).

| Choice | Decision | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Location | Pure TypeScript in `@ezdraft/geometry`, no imports, no DOM, no Node APIs; runs in browser, Web Worker and Node. | architecture `Folder layout` (packages/geometry); 11 Where each output is produced |
| D2 Pre-checks | `s = text.trim()`. `s.length === 0` or `s.length > 32` → refuse `format`. 32 bounds the work; the longest form in the sources (`200' 0 1/16"`) is 12 characters. | planner, robustness (CLAUDE.md rule 18); 09j rows |
| D3 Quote marks | After trimming, replace U+2018 and U+2019 with `'`, and U+201C and U+201D with `"`. Primes U+2032, U+2033 and any other mark are not replaced, so they refuse `format`. | Q-0561 (straight or curly quote marks); Q-0570 (curly marks as tablet keyboards type them; anything else refused) |
| D4 Grammar | Whole match, one of three shapes, tried in order; regexes in E8. **A** decimal feet alone: `^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)'$`. **B** whole feet, then a hyphen right after the mark or zero or more spaces, then an inch part, then an optional `"`. **C** an inch part alone, then an optional `"`. Inch part, three alternatives tried in this order: a whole number, then one or more spaces or one hyphen, then `<int>/<int>`; or a lone fraction `<int>/<int>` (`1/2"` = 0.5, `12' 1/2"` = 144.5, Q-0582 (a)); or a number `\d+(?:\.\d+)?`. `\d` is ASCII 0–9 only (no `u` flag). Spaces are U+0020 only, and only after the foot mark and between the whole number and the fraction. Anything that matches none of A, B, C refuses `format`. | 01 Conventions; 04 Measurement entry; Q-0561; Q-0570 (12 1/2, 6-1/2", 6.5", 12' 6 accepted; anything else refused); Q-0582 (a) (lone fraction accepted as inches); 09j rows 1–24 |
| D5 What the grammar refuses | `12 6`, `12 6"` (no fraction, Q-0561, 09j row 9); any sign, so `-5"` and `+5"` (no accepted form has one, Q-0570); `.5"`, `5."`, `12,5'`; a space before a mark (`150 "`, `12 '`); spaces around a hyphen (`12' - 6"`, `6 - 1/2"`) or the slash (`1 / 2"`); decimal feet followed by inches (`12.5' 3"`; 12.5' is shown only alone, 09j row 4); two foot marks (`12'6'`). A fraction with no whole number is not refused (D4, Q-0582 (a)). | Q-0570 "anything else is refused" |
| D6 Fraction rule | Denominator 0, or numerator ≥ denominator → refuse `format`. Any other denominator is accepted (the value is rounded in D8). | 03g Typed lengths (rounded to 1/16 when read); 09j rows 2, 7, 12, 16–19 (proper fractions only) |
| D7 Value | A: feet × 12. B: feet × 12 + inch part. C: inch part. Inch part with a fraction: whole + numerator / denominator; a lone fraction: numerator / denominator. Inches after feet may be 12 or more (`12' 15"` = 159): the shape is the listed `12' 6"` shape and no source limits the inch part. Leading zeros are allowed (`0150"` = 150). | 09j; Q-0570 (shapes) |
| D8 Rounding | `inches = Math.floor(value * 16 + 0.5) / 16` (nearest 1/16, halfway up). | 03g Typed lengths (*settled here*); 09j row 10 |
| D9 Field limits | Only when `kind === 'wall_room'`, after D8: `inches <= 0` → refuse `not_positive`; `inches > 2400` → refuse `over_max`. `kind === 'other'` has no range check (0" accepted). Checks run D2 → D9 in order, so a malformed text always reports `format`. | Q-0568 (above zero, at most 200 ft); Q-0570 (wall and room fields only, after rounding; other fields accept 0"); 03g row 9 |
| D10 Refusal result | Every refusal returns `{ ok: false, reason, messageKey: 'office.length.refused' }`: one message for every reason. | AC-EZD-201-5; Q-0561; S01 Validation (`S01-projects.md` line 110) |
| D11 Message namespace | `office.` key, English only: length boxes in phases 2–4 are office screens (S01 wizard, S03 editor). A phone screen that types lengths later adds its own Spanish key. | architecture `Messages and language (t())` (office keys English only) |
| D12 Display rounding | `n = Math.floor(inches * d + 0.5)` (units of 1/d inch; halfway up), then integer maths: `feet = Math.floor(n / (12 * d))`, `rem = n - feet * 12 * d`, `whole = Math.floor(rem / d)`, `num = rem - whole * d`; reduce `num/d` by their greatest common divisor. Rounding carries into inches and feet (143.75 → `12' 0"`). | Q-0207; 09j rows 10–12; 03g rows 6–9 |
| D13 Display text | feet > 0: `<feet>' <whole>"` or `<feet>' <whole> <num>/<den>"` (whole always shown, `1' 0 1/2"`, `10' 0"`). feet = 0: `<whole>"`, `<whole> <num>/<den>"`, or `<num>/<den>"` when whole is 0 and num > 0 (`5/8"`); 0 → `0"`. Straight ASCII marks, one space between parts, no digit grouping. | 09j rows 1–24 (`6 1/2"`, `1' 0 1/2"`, `200' 0"`); 03g row 9; Q-0568 (S02 board "5/8" gap") |
| D14 Bad display input | `formatLength` throws `RangeError` when `inches` is not finite or is below 0, or when `denominator` is not 2 or 16 (runtime check; the type is `2 \| 16`). | planner: lengths are never negative (Q-0568); a bad call is a programming error |
