# EZD-354 · Build system: the gate's checks run as the separate ezdraft macOS user, so code they run cannot reach Josh's keychain or files

- **ACs:** AC-EZD-354-1, AC-EZD-354-2, AC-EZD-354-3 (`vault/spec/acceptance-criteria.md` rows 578-580)
- **Complexity:** high (section 8)
- **Areas:** tooling, scripts, security, testing
- **User-visible result:** on Josh's Mac every check the gate runs (install, typecheck, lint, tests, build, browser tests, perf) runs as the `ezdraft` user from a copy outside Josh's home, so code in a ticket can no longer read Josh's files, keychain, ssh agent or Claude sessions; CI is unchanged.
- Phase: 1 · Planned by: planner · Date: 2026-11-06 · Status: questions

## Josh's steps
Only Josh can do these (account, sudo, Docker Desktop settings). Order: steps 1 and 2 before the build; step 3 after the orchestrator's row O1. Probe 2026-11-06: none is done yet (`ls -led /Users/josh` has only `group:everyone deny delete`; `/etc/sudoers.d` is empty).

1. **Close your home folder to ezdraft.** Both users are in group `staff` and `/Users/josh` is `drwxr-x---` josh:staff, so ezdraft can list and read most of it. In Terminal (no sudo; you own the folder):
   `chmod +a "user:ezdraft deny list,search,add_file,add_subdirectory,delete_child,readattr,readextattr,readsecurity" /Users/josh`
   Check: `ls -led /Users/josh` shows a `user:ezdraft deny list,add_file,search,…` line.
2. **Let the gate switch to ezdraft without a password, for one command only.** `sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/ezdraft-gate`, type exactly this line, save:
   `josh ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /bin/launchctl asuser 502 /usr/bin/sudo -n -u ezdraft -- /usr/bin/env *`
   Check: `sudo -n /bin/launchctl asuser 502 /usr/bin/sudo -n -u ezdraft -- /usr/bin/env -i /usr/bin/id -un` prints `ezdraft`.
3. **Limit what Docker containers can see** (after row O1). Docker Desktop → Settings → Resources → File sharing: remove `/Users`, `/Volumes`, `/private`, `/tmp`, `/var/folders`; add `/Users/josh/Projects/ezdraft/.claude/worktrees` and `/Users/ezdraft/gate`; Apply & restart. Why: the Docker VM mounts exactly the listed folders (probe 2026-11-06: a privileged container saw `/host_mnt/Users`, `/Volumes`, `/private`, `/tmp`, `/var/folders`), so today any container reads your whole home.

## 1. What to build
Builder: the orchestrator in interactive fix mode for every non-test row (`scripts/` root and `vault/tools/` are denied to the builder, `.claude/hooks/guard-paths.mjs`; `scripts/gate.mjs`, `scripts/gate-env.mjs`, `vault/tools/trusted-git.mjs`, `scripts/launcher-idle.mjs` are in `REPAIR_NEVER_FILES`, `scripts/launcher-idle.mjs:82`; pattern of `vault/plans/EZD-344.md` section 1). Tests (section 4) are the test-author's, written first. Merge develop into the worktree before the gate (L-053). Gate parts this ticket can turn red: `lint` (conventions on new `scripts/` files), `test` (section 4 and the structural edits), and every check through the new switch (O2). Verify commands that spawn a gate exit 3 (GATE SANDBOX STOP) inside the unit sandbox (seen 2026-11-06 on `gate-env.test.mjs` E6, E7): run them unsandboxed.
Open before the build: Q-0610, Q-0611 (section 10; answered-agent) and Josh's steps 1-2.

security-review: yes. Areas: permissions (OS user boundary, sudoers rule, file ACLs), data access (Josh's home, keychain, Docker host mounts).

## 8. Complexity and model recommendation
High: a new OS security boundary with a root sudoers rule, a copy-and-sync path, a relay process and changes to the gate every ticket depends on; its proof needs the real machine (O2). Test-author: claude-opus-5-5. Builder: the orchestrator (Opus) in fix mode for every non-test row.

- EZD-344 (gate-env; done), EZD-345 (trusted-git; done). Missing from the ticket row: EZD-172 (lanes, `scripts/db/lane.mjs`; done) and Josh's steps 1-3 (no ticket; they gate the build and O2).

- Q-0611 (answered-agent, (a)): The build-system freeze (CLAUDE.md rule 18) needs Josh's yes on a one-line why and cost, and no decisions row records it for EZD-354; options are (a) record his creating the ezdraft user for Q-0602 (a) as that yes (why: code the gate runs can reach his keychain and files; cost: one fix-mode session, his three steps, tens of seconds per gate), or (b) ask Josh for an explicit yes before the build.
